-- Cloudy: full main source with integrated Auto Run and independent viewmodel effects.
local CloudyKernel=[========[
-- Auto Run lives in this main source and queues this same complete source.
local bootstrapText,bodyText,expectedGameId,fromTeleport,revision=CloudyKernel,CloudySource,CloudyGameId,CloudyTeleported,CloudyRevision
local env=getgenv()
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
if expectedGameId and game.GameId~=expectedGameId then return end
expectedGameId=expectedGameId or game.GameId
local current=env.LeeLinRebuild
if fromTeleport and (env.LeeLinAutoRunLaunching or (current and not current.destroyed)) then return end

local SETTINGS="LeeLin/autorun.json"
local http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local function resolve(name,fallback)
    local value=env[name]
    return type(value)=="function" and value or (type(fallback)=="function" and fallback or nil)
end
local read=resolve("readfile",readfile)
local write=resolve("writefile",writefile)
local queue=resolve("queue_on_teleport",queue_on_teleport) or resolve("queueonteleport",queueonteleport)
local namespace=env.syn or syn
if not queue and type(namespace)=="table" then queue=namespace.queue_on_teleport end
namespace=env.fluxus or fluxus
if not queue and type(namespace)=="table" then queue=namespace.queue_on_teleport end
if type(queue)~="function" then queue=nil end
local enabled=true
if read then
    local ok,state=pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(read(SETTINGS)) end)
    if ok and type(state)=="table" then
        if fromTeleport and state.Revision and state.Revision~=revision then return end
        if type(state.Enabled)=="boolean" then enabled=state.Enabled end
    end
end
if fromTeleport and not enabled then return end

local previous=env.LeeLinInlineAutoRun
if previous and type(previous.Destroy)=="function" then previous:Destroy(false) end
local state={enabled=enabled,queued=false,connections={},revision=revision,destroyed=false}
env.LeeLinInlineAutoRun=state
local entry="local CloudyKernel=%q\nlocal CloudySource=%q\nlocal CloudyGameId=%s\nlocal CloudyTeleported=true\nlocal CloudyRevision=%q\n"
function state:_Persist()
    if not write then return end
    local make=resolve("makefolder",makefolder)
    if make then pcall(make,"LeeLin") end
    local ok,problem=pcall(function()
        write(SETTINGS,http:JSONEncode({Enabled=self.enabled,GameId=expectedGameId,PlaceId=game.PlaceId,Revision=revision}))
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[LeeLin.gg] Could not save Auto Run preference: "..tostring(problem)) end
end
function state:Queue()
    if self.destroyed or not self.enabled or self.queued then return end
    if not queue then
        if not self.queueWarning then self.queueWarning=true;warn("[LeeLin.gg] This executor does not expose a teleport queue") end
        return
    end
    local AUTORUN_URL='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wb6vz6ymz7-code/LeeLin.gg/refs/heads/main/README.md'
    local source=string.format([==[
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
getgenv().LeeLinAutoRunLaunching=true
local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local src = game:HttpGet(%q)
    assert(type(src)=="string" and #src>0, "empty response from autorun url")
    local fn, cerr = loadstring(src)
    assert(fn, tostring(cerr))
    return fn()
end)
getgenv().LeeLinAutoRunLaunching=nil
if not ok then
    warn("[LeeLin.gg AutoRun] "..tostring(err))
end
]==], AUTORUN_URL)
    local ok,problem=pcall(queue,source)
    if ok then self.queued=true
    else warn("[LeeLin.gg] Could not queue the autorun URL script: "..tostring(problem)) end
end
function state:SetEnabled(value)
    if self.destroyed then return end
    self.enabled=value==true
    self:_Persist()
    if self.enabled then self:Queue() end
end
function state:Destroy(disable)
    if self.destroyed then return end
    if disable then self.enabled=false;self:_Persist() end
    self.destroyed=true
    for _,connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self.connections)
    if env.LeeLinInlineAutoRun==self then env.LeeLinInlineAutoRun=nil end
end
local function bindPlayer(player)
    if not player or state.player==player then return end
    state.player=player
    table.insert(state.connections,player.OnTeleport:Connect(function(teleportState)
        if teleportState==Enum.TeleportState.Started then
            state:Queue()
        elseif teleportState==Enum.TeleportState.Failed then
            -- The executor may consume its queue on a failed teleport; re-arm on the next attempt.
            state.queued=false
        end
    end))
end
local players=game:GetService("Players")
bindPlayer(players.LocalPlayer)
if not players.LocalPlayer then
    table.insert(state.connections,players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Connect(function() bindPlayer(players.LocalPlayer) end))
end
state:_Persist()
state:Queue()
env.LeeLinAutoRunLaunching=true
]========]

--==========================================================================
--  Signal / Trove (Kicia's own small versions)
--==========================================================================
local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal
function Signal.new() return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} }, Signal) end
function Signal:Connect(fn)
    local h = { fn = fn, connected = true }
    table.insert(self._handlers, h)
    local sig = self
    return {
        Connected = true,
        Disconnect = function(c)
            if not h.connected then return end
            h.connected = false
            c.Connected = false
            local i = table.find(sig._handlers, h)
            if i then table.remove(sig._handlers, i) end
        end,
    }
end
function Signal:Once(fn)
    local c
    c = self:Connect(function(...) c:Disconnect(); fn(...) end)
    return c
end
function Signal:Fire(...)
    local list = table.clone(self._handlers)
    for _, h in ipairs(list) do
        if h.connected then task.spawn(h.fn, ...) end
    end
end
function Signal:FireSync(...)
    for _, h in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
        if h.connected then h.fn(...) end
    end
end
function Signal:Destroy() table.clear(self._handlers) end
K.Signal = Signal

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove
function Trove.new(name) return setmetatable({ _name = name, _items = {} }, Trove) end
local function cleanItem(o)
    local t = typeof(o)
    if t == "RBXScriptConnection" then o:Disconnect()
    elseif t == "Instance" then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
    elseif t == "thread" then pcall(task.cancel, o)
    elseif type(o) == "function" then pcall(o)
    elseif type(o) == "table" then
        --  some objects (Kicia's signal connections) error on unknown fields
        local function member(k)
            local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
            return ok and type(v) == "function" and v or nil
        end
        local cancel, getStatus = member("cancel"), member("getStatus")
        if cancel and getStatus then pcall(cancel, o); return end
        local destroy = member("Destroy")
        if destroy then pcall(destroy, o); return end
        local disconnect = member("Disconnect")
        if disconnect then pcall(disconnect, o) end
    end
end
function Trove:Add(o) table.insert(self._items, o); return o end
function Trove:Connect(sig, fn) return self:Add(sig:Connect(fn)) end
function Trove:Extend() return self:Add(Trove.new(self._name)) end
function Trove:Remove(o, keep)
    local i = table.find(self._items, o)
    if i then
        table.remove(self._items, i)
        if not keep then cleanItem(o) end
    end
end
--  Promise held until it settles; cancelled if the trove is cleaned first.
function Trove:AddPromise(promise)
    if tostring(promise:getStatus()) == "Started" then
        self:Add(promise)
        promise:finally(function()
            if not self._cleaning then self:Remove(promise, true) end
        end)
    end
    return promise
end
--  Sub-trove that cleans itself up when `instance` is destroyed.
function Trove:AttachExtend(instance)
    local sub = self:Extend()
    sub:Connect(instance.Destroying, function() self:Remove(sub) end)
    return sub
end
function Trove:Clean()
    local items = self._items
    self._items = {}
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #items, 1, -1 do cleanItem(items[i]) end
    self._cleaning = false
end
Trove.Destroy = Trove.Clean
K.Trove = Trove

        if kind == nil then return nil end

        return ok and v or nil
    end
    function W.findScrollingAncestor(inst)
        local p = inst and inst.Parent
        while p ~= nil do
            if p:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return p end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    function W.isEffectivelyVisible(gui)
        local p = gui
        while p ~= nil and p ~= game do
            if p:IsA("GuiObject") and not p.Visible then return false end
            if p:IsA("LayerCollector") then return p.Enabled end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    function W.ensureStorageDirectories(dir)
        local isf, mkf = K.fn("isfolder"), K.fn("makefolder")
        if not (isf and mkf) or type(dir) ~= "string" then return end
        local function make(path)
            local acc
            for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
                acc = acc and (acc .. "/" .. part) or part
                pcall(function() if not isf(acc) then mkf(acc) end end)
            end
        end
        make(dir)
        make(dir .. "/configs")
    end
    tbl17.w = function() return W end
end

--  P: two-way link between a control and a settings path. Sliders ask for
--  Debounce so dragging writes once per short burst instead of every frame.
do
    local P = {}
    function P.bind(trove, config, control, path, opts)
        local debounce = opts ~= nil and opts.Debounce == true
        local writeBack = opts ~= nil and opts.WriteBack or nil
        control:Set(config:Get(path), true)
        trove:Connect(config:Changed(path), function(v) control:Set(v, true) end)
        local pending, scheduled = nil, false
        local function write(v)
            if writeBack then writeBack(v) else config:Set(path, v) end
        end
        trove:Connect(control.Changed, function(v)
            if not debounce then write(v); return end
            pending = v
            if scheduled then return end
            scheduled = true
            task.delay(0.05, function()
                scheduled = false
                write(pending)
            end)
        end)
    end
    tbl17.P = function() return P end
end

--  c5: the critically damped Spring (Position, Velocity, Target, Speed, Damper).
do
    local Spring = {}
    local function posVel(self, now)
        local p0, v0, p1, d, s = self._p0, self._v0, self._target, self._damper, self._speed
        local t = s * (now - self._t0)
        local d2 = d * d
        local h, si, co
        if d2 < 1 then
            h = math.sqrt(1 - d2)
            local ep = math.exp(-d * t) / h
            co, si = ep * math.cos(h * t), ep * math.sin(h * t)
        elseif d2 == 1 then
            h = 1
            local ep = math.exp(-d * t) / h
            co, si = ep, ep * t
        else
            h = math.sqrt(d2 - 1)
            local u, v = math.exp((-d + h) * t) / (2 * h), math.exp((-d - h) * t) / (2 * h)
            co, si = u + v, u - v
        end
        local a0, a1 = h * co + d * si, 1 - (h * co + d * si)
        local a2 = si / s
        local b0, b1, b2 = -s * si, s * si, h * co - d * si
        return a0 * p0 + a1 * p1 + a2 * v0, b0 * p0 + b1 * p1 + b2 * v0
    end
    function Spring.new(initial, clock)
        initial = initial or 0
        clock = clock or os.clock
        return setmetatable({ _clock = clock, _t0 = clock(), _p0 = initial, _v0 = 0 * initial, _target = initial,
            _damper = 1, _speed = 1 }, Spring)
    end
    function Spring:Impulse(v) self.Velocity = self.Velocity + v end
    function Spring:SetTarget(value, doNotAnimate)
        if doNotAnimate then
            self._p0, self._v0, self._target, self._t0 = value, 0 * value, value, self._clock()
        else
            self.Target = value
        end
    end
    function Spring:TimeSkip(delta)
        local now = self._clock()
        local p, v = posVel(self, now + delta)
        self._p0, self._v0, self._t0 = p, v, now
    end
    Spring.__index = function(self, k)
        if Spring[k] then return Spring[k] end
        if k == "Value" or k == "Position" or k == "p" then local p = posVel(self, self._clock()); return p
        elseif k == "Velocity" or k == "v" then local _, v = posVel(self, self._clock()); return v
        elseif k == "Target" or k == "t" then return self._target
        elseif k == "Damper" or k == "d" then return self._damper
        elseif k == "Speed" or k == "s" then return self._speed
        elseif k == "Clock" then return self._clock end
        return nil
    end
    Spring.__newindex = function(self, k, v)
        local now = self._clock()
        if k == "Value" or k == "Position" or k == "p" then
            local _, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0 = v, vel
        elseif k == "Velocity" or k == "v" then
            local pos = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0 = pos, v
        elseif k == "Target" or k == "t" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._target = pos, vel, v
        elseif k == "Damper" or k == "d" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._damper = pos, vel, v
        elseif k == "Speed" or k == "s" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._p0, self._v0, self._speed = pos, vel, v < 0 and 0 or v
        elseif k == "Clock" then
            local pos, vel = posVel(self, now)
            self._clock, self._t0, self._p0, self._v0 = v, v(), pos, vel
            return
        else
            rawset(self, k, v)
            return
        end
        self._t0 = now
    end
    tbl17.c5 = function() return Spring end
end

    function Offline:IsConnected() return false end
    function Offline:Send() return tbl17.a().err("UserServer", "offline", "the online user service is disabled") end
    function Offline:FindPlayerByHash() return nil end
    function Offline:Connect() return tbl17.ay().reject("the online user service is disabled") end
    function Offline:Destroy()
        self.Connected:Destroy()
        self.ShowActiveChanged:Destroy()
        self.PeerPayloadReceived:Destroy()
        self.PeerRemoved:Destroy()
        self.ShowActivated:Destroy()
        self._leaving:Disconnect()
    end
    return Offline
end

end

        FadeIn=Style.Number(b.FadeIn,.03,0,.5),FadeCurve=b.FadeCurve,Opacity=Style.Number(b.Opacity,.9,0,1),
        EndTransparency=Style.Number(b.EndTransparency,.4,0,1),Emission=Style.Number(b.Emission,1,0,1),
        Brightness=1+(Style.Number(b.Glow,1,1,25)-1)*.25,Texture=Textures.ByName[b.Style] or "",

    if not inner or not Store.Data.BulletTracers.Enabled then return end
    local args=event.Args

    local b=Store.Data.BulletTracers
    local maxActive=math.floor(Style.Number(b.MaxActive,64,1,256))

function Controller:Update(dt)
    local b=Store.Data.BulletTracers
    local limit=math.floor(Style.Number(b.MaxActive,64,1,256))
    while #self._tracers>limit do table.remove(self._tracers,1):Destroy() end

    end
end
function Controller:Destroy() self._trove:Destroy() end

end

function Weather:_FireStrike()

    local to=Vector3.new(x,floorY,z)

            elseif Asset.classify(normalized)=="Asset" then self._soundId=normalized

    end
end
function Weather:_PlayThunder(distance,volume,delayed,id)

    table.insert(self._pendingThunder,{At=os.clock()+(delayed and distance/Specs.ThunderSpeed or 0),Id=id,
        Volume=number(volume,1,0,3)*math.max(Specs.ThunderVolumeFloor,1-distance/Specs.ThunderFalloff),
        Pitch=Specs.ThunderPitchMin+math.random()*(Specs.ThunderPitchMax-Specs.ThunderPitchMin)})
end
function Weather:_UpdateThunder(now)

function Weather:Update()

end

end

do -- hK
local function fn35()
local AtmosphereController=tbl17.hh()
local LightingController=tbl17.hi()
local LightningController=tbl17.hC()
local MotionBlurController=tbl17.hD()
local PostEffectController=tbl17.hF()
local SkyController=tbl17.hG()
local Trove=tbl17.k()
local WeatherController=tbl17.hI()
local PostEffects=tbl17.hJ()
local Snapshot=tbl17.kU()
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local WorldVisuals={}
WorldVisuals.__index=WorldVisuals

function WorldVisuals.new(skyboxes,context,duelers)
    local self=setmetatable({_trove=Trove.new("world_visuals"),
        _worldTrove=Trove.new("world_visuals.LobbyOverrides"),
        _reportTrove=Trove.new("world_visuals.MatchReport"),
        _skyboxes=skyboxes,_player=Players.LocalPlayer,_context=context,_duelers=duelers,
        _contextTrove=Trove.new("world_visuals.Context"),_stateElapsed=0,
        _destroyed=false,_records={},_errors={}},WorldVisuals)
    self._trove:Add(self._worldTrove)
    self._trove:Add(self._reportTrove)
    self._trove:Add(self._contextTrove)
    self:_ClearOwnedEffects()
    -- Sky presets are independent of the lobby-only Lighting/Atmosphere overrides.
    self._skyController=self._trove:Add(SkyController.new(self._skyboxes))
    self._motionBlurController=self._trove:Add(MotionBlurController.new())
    local lightning=self._trove:Add(LightningController.new())
    lightning:Initialise()
    self._weatherController=self._trove:Add(WeatherController.new(lightning))
    for _,spec in PostEffects do
        if spec.ClassName=="ColorCorrectionEffect" then
            self._colorController=self._trove:Add(PostEffectController.new(spec))
            break
        end
    end
    if self._player then
        self._trove:Connect(self._player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EnvironmentID"),function() self:_EnvironmentChanged() end)
    end
    if context then
        self._trove:Connect(context.ContextAdded,function() self:_BindContext() end)
        self._trove:Connect(context.ContextRemoved,function() self:_BindContext() end)
    end
    if duelers then
        self._trove:Connect(duelers.LocalStateSet,function() self:_EnvironmentChanged() end)
        self._trove:Connect(duelers.LocalStateRemoved,function() self:_EnvironmentChanged() end)
    end
    K.WorldVisuals=self
    self:_BindContext()
    return self
end

function WorldVisuals:_ClearOwnedEffects()
    local current=self._colorController and self._colorController:Get()
    for _,root in {game:GetService("Lighting"),workspace.CurrentCamera} do
        if root then
            for _,effect in root:GetChildren() do
                if effect~=current and effect:IsA("PostEffect") and effect.Name:sub(1,7)=="Cloudy_" then
                    effect:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function WorldVisuals:_BindContext()
    self._contextTrove:Clean()
    local inner=self._context and self._context.Inner
    local fighter=inner and inner.FighterState
    if fighter and fighter.EnvironmentIdChanged then
        self._contextTrove:Connect(fighter.EnvironmentIdChanged,function() self:_EnvironmentChanged() end)
    end
    self:_EnvironmentChanged()
end

function WorldVisuals:_IsMatch()
    if self._duelers and self._duelers.LocalState~=nil then
        self._matchSource="DuelState";return true
    end
    local inner=self._context and self._context.Inner
    local fighter=inner and inner.FighterState
    local fighterId=fighter and fighter.EnvironmentId
    local playerId=self._player and self._player:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
    if fighterId~=nil and fighterId~=false and fighterId~="" and fighterId~="Lobby" then
        self._matchSource="FighterEnvironment";return true
    end
    if playerId~=nil and playerId~=false and playerId~="" and playerId~="Lobby" then
        self._matchSource="PlayerEnvironment";return true
    end
    if playerId=="Lobby" or (self._player and (self._player:GetAttribute("InLobby")==true
        or self._player:GetAttribute("IsInLobby")==true)) then
        self._matchSource="ConfirmedLobby";return false
    end
    -- Missing replicated attributes are not proof of being in the lobby.
    self._matchSource="SafeDefault";return true
end

function WorldVisuals:_AddWorldController(name,create)
    local ok,result=pcall(create)
    if ok and result then
        self._worldTrove:Add(result)
    else
        local message=name..": "..tostring(result)
        table.insert(self._errors,message)
        warn("[Cloudy Visuals] "..message)
    end
end

function WorldVisuals:_SetMatchState(inMatch)
    if self._inMatch==inMatch then return end
    self._inMatch=inMatch
    self._worldTrove:Clean()
    if inMatch then self:_ClearOwnedEffects();return end
    self:_AddWorldController("Lighting",function() return LightingController.new() end)
    self:_AddWorldController("Atmosphere",function() return AtmosphereController.new() end)
    for _,spec in PostEffects do
        if spec.ClassName~="ColorCorrectionEffect" then
            self:_AddWorldController(spec.ClassName,function() return PostEffectController.new(spec) end)
        end
    end
end

function WorldVisuals:_SaveReport(reason)
    if self._destroyed or K.EnableVisualDiagnostics~=true then return end
    local ok,record=pcall(Snapshot.Capture,self._inMatch,reason)
    if not ok then return end
    record.MatchDetection=self._matchSource
    table.insert(self._records,record)
    while #self._records>6 do table.remove(self._records,1) end
    local write=K.fn("writefile") or writefile
    if type(write)=="function" then
        pcall(function()
            local report={Version=1,Records=self._records,ControllerErrors=self._errors}
            write("LeeLin/visual_state.json",game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(report))
        end)
    end
end

function WorldVisuals:_EnvironmentChanged()
    if self._destroyed then return end
    self:_SetMatchState(self:_IsMatch())
    self._reportTrove:Clean()
    if K.EnableVisualDiagnostics~=true then return end
    self:_SaveReport("EnvironmentChanged")
    if self._inMatch then
        for _,delay in {1,4} do
            self._reportTrove:Add(task.delay(delay,function() self:_SaveReport("Match+"..delay) end))
        end
    end
end

function WorldVisuals:PreRender(dt)
    if self._destroyed then return end
    self._stateElapsed+=dt
    if self._stateElapsed>=.2 then
        self._stateElapsed=0
        if self:_IsMatch()~=self._inMatch then self:_EnvironmentChanged() end
    end
    self._motionBlurController:PreRender(dt)
    self._weatherController:Update()
end

function WorldVisuals:Destroy()
    if self._destroyed then return end
    self._destroyed=true
    if K.WorldVisuals==self then K.WorldVisuals=nil end
    self._trove:Destroy()
    self._colorController=nil
    self:_ClearOwnedEffects()
end
return WorldVisuals
end

    surface:AddColor({Row=tint.Row,Config=path("Appearance","Color"),Animatable=true})

    chams:AddColor({Label=label.." Fill Color",Config=path("Highlight","FillColor"),Animatable=true})
    chams:AddSlider({Label=label.." Fill Transparency",Min=0,Max=1,Step=.01,Config=path("Highlight","FillTransparency")})
    chams:AddToggle({Label=label.." Through Walls",Config=path("Highlight","ThroughWalls")})
    section:AddDivider({Label=label.." Wireframe"})
    local wire=section:AddToggle({Label=label.." Wireframe",Config=path("Wireframe","Enabled"),Tooltip="Draws stable 1px mesh lines, over fill when enabled."})

function Spec.Defaults()
 local out={Values={},Binds={}}
 for _,panel in ipairs(Spec.Panels) do for _,c in ipairs(panel.Controls) do
 out.Values[c.Id]=c.Default
 if c.Kind=="Toggle" then out.Binds[c.Id]={Kind="Always",State=false,ShowInList=c.Main,Invisible=false} end
 end end
 return out
end
return Spec

end
tbl17.kL=function()
 local cached=tbl17.cache.kL
 if not cached then cached={c=fn35()};tbl17.cache.kL=cached end
 return cached.c
end
end
do -- kM
local function fn35()
-- The requested reference panels share one owned, non-yielding runtime.
local Spec = tbl17.kL()
local Shot = tbl17.kW()
local Players = cloneref(game:GetService("Players"))
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Engine = {}
Engine.__index = Engine
local TAU = math.pi * 2
local ZERO = Vector3.zero
local ENABLES = {CFG="VOID_ENABLED",cfg="orbitEnabled",cfgDodge="predEnabled",antiBaitCFG="enabled",
    aaSettings="enabled",translocCFG="enabled",slingCFG="enabled",riotGodmodeCFG="enabled",riotAbuserCFG="enabled"}

local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e30 end
local function validVector(v)
    return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z)
end
local function validCF(cf)
    if typeof(cf)~="CFrame" then return false end
    for _,n in ipairs({cf:GetComponents()}) do if not finite(n) then return false end end
    return true
end
local function unit(v, fallback) return v.Magnitude>0.001 and v.Unit or (fallback or Vector3.xAxis) end
local function randomBetween(a,b) return math.min(a,b)+math.random()*math.abs(b-a) end
local function alpha(smoothing,dt) return 1-(1-math.clamp(smoothing,0,1))^(math.clamp(dt,0,0.1)*60) end
local function face(position,target)
    if (position-target).Magnitude<0.001 then return CFrame.new(position) end
    return CFrame.lookAt(position,target)
end
local function clean(list)
    for _,c in ipairs(list) do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(list)
end
local function write(object,prop,value) pcall(function() object[prop]=value end) end
local function normalized(c,value)
    if c.Kind=="Toggle" then return type(value)=="boolean" and value or (value==nil and c.Default==true) end
    if c.Kind=="Dropdown" then return table.find(c.Options,value) and value or c.Default end
    if not finite(value) then return c.Default end
    return math.clamp(value,c.Min,c.Max)
end

function Engine.new(context)
    return setmetatable({context=context,C=Spec.Configs(),connections={},enemies={},parts={},modified={},
        expanded={},time=0,nextScan=0,nextThreat=0,nextShot=0,nextNotice=0,active=false,destroyed=false,
        angles={},timers={},previousEnabled={},enabled={},dodge=nil,lockedTarget=nil,shotBusy=false},Engine)
end

function Engine:_HasActive()
    for group,field in pairs(ENABLES) do if self.C[group][field] then return true end end
    return false
end

function Engine:Sync(saved)
    if self.destroyed then return end
    saved=type(saved)=="table" and saved or {}
    local values=type(saved.Values)=="table" and saved.Values or {}
    local binds=type(saved.Binds)=="table" and saved.Binds or {}
    for _,panel in ipairs(Spec.Panels) do for _,c in ipairs(panel.Controls) do
        local v=normalized(c,values[c.Id])
        if c.Kind=="Toggle" and v then
            local b=binds[c.Id]
            if type(b)=="table" and (b.Kind=="Hold" or b.Kind=="Toggle") then v=b.State==true end
        end
        self.C[c.Group][c.Field]=c.Map(v)
    end end
    for group,field in pairs(ENABLES) do
        local enabled=self.C[group][field]==true
        if self.previousEnabled[group]~=enabled then
            self.timers[group]=0
            self.angles[group]=0
            if group=="CFG" then
                if enabled then
                    local _,root=self:_Local()
                    self.voidReturn=root and root.CFrame
                    self.voidPosition=root and root.Position
                elseif self.voidReturn then
                    local _,root=self:_Local()
                    self.networkPose=nil
                    self.voidReturn=nil
                end
            end
            if group=="translocCFG" then
                if enabled then self:_StartTranslocCore() else self:_StopTranslocCore(); self:_ClearFake() end
            end
            if group=="slingCFG" and not enabled then self.lockedTarget=nil;self.followPosition=nil end
            self.previousEnabled[group]=enabled
        end
    end
    if not self.C.cfgDodge.predEnabled and not self.C.antiBaitCFG.enabled then self.dodge=nil end
    self:_RefreshProperties()
    local active=self:_HasActive()
    if active and not self.active then
        self.active=true
        self.nextScan=0
    elseif not active and self.active then
        self.active=false
        self:_ResetCharacter()
        self:_ClearEnemies()
    end
end

function Engine:Update(dt)
    if self.destroyed or not self.active or self.busy then return end
    self.busy=true
    local ok,err=pcall(self.Step,self,dt)
    self.busy=false
    if not ok and os.clock()>=(self.nextError or 0) then
        self.nextError=os.clock()+10
        warn("[Cloudy HvH] "..tostring(err))
    end
end

function Engine:_Local()
    local fighters=self.context.HvhFighters
    local state=fighters and fighters.LocalState
    local alive=state and state.Character.State
    if alive and alive.Alive then return alive.Model,alive.RootPart,alive.Humanoid,state end
    -- The fighter registry can be between CharacterAdded and its own initialization.
    local char=LocalPlayer.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if root and hum and hum.Health>0 then return char,root,hum,state end
    return nil
end

function Engine:_Inner()
    local context=self.context.HvhPlayerContext
    return context and context.Inner
end

function Engine:_ClearFake()
    local inner=self:_Inner()
    if inner then
        inner.CharacterController:SetServerCFrame(nil,"CloudyHvH")
        inner.CharacterController:SetServerCFrame(nil,"CloudyHvHShot")
        inner.CharacterController:SetServerVelocity(nil,nil,"CloudyHvH")
    end
    self.fakeApplied=false;self.networkPose=nil
end

function Engine:_RestoreParts()
    for part,saved in pairs(self.modified) do
        if part.Parent then for key,v in pairs(saved) do write(part,key,v) end end
    end
    table.clear(self.modified)
end

function Engine:_RestoreExpanded()
    for part,saved in pairs(self.expanded) do
        if part.Parent then for key,v in pairs(saved) do write(part,key,v) end end
    end
    table.clear(self.expanded)
end

function Engine:_ResetCharacter()
    self:_ClearFake()
    local inner=self:_Inner()
    if inner and self.viewApplied then inner.CharacterController:SendViewAngles(25,nil) end
    self.viewApplied=false
    self:_RestoreParts()
    self:_RestoreExpanded()
    if self.partAdded then self.partAdded:Disconnect();self.partAdded=nil end
    if self.partRemoved then self.partRemoved:Disconnect();self.partRemoved=nil end
    if self.humanoid and self.humanoid.Parent and self.originalAutoRotate~=nil then
        self.humanoid.AutoRotate=self.originalAutoRotate
        if self.humanoid.Health>0 and self.humanoid:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
            self.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end
    end
    if self.originalDestroyHeight~=nil then
        local rage=self.context.HvhRagebot
        if not (rage and rage._enabled) then pcall(function() v112(workspace,"FallenPartsDestroyHeight",self.originalDestroyHeight) end) end
        self.originalDestroyHeight=nil
    end
    self.character=nil;self.root=nil;self.humanoid=nil;self.originalAutoRotate=nil
    self.followPosition=nil;self.voidPosition=nil;self.voidReturn=nil;self.dodge=nil;self.positioningActive=false
    self.networkOwnerAttempted=nil
    table.clear(self.parts)
end

function Engine:_BindCharacter(char,root,hum)
    self:_ResetCharacter()
    self.character=char;self.root=root;self.humanoid=hum
    self.originalAutoRotate=hum.AutoRotate
    for _,part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then self.parts[part]=true end end
    self.partAdded=char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part) if part:IsA("BasePart") then self.parts[part]=true;self.propertiesDirty=true end end)
    self.partRemoved=char.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(part)
        local saved=self.modified[part]
        if saved then for prop,value in pairs(saved) do write(part,prop,value) end end
        self.parts[part]=nil;self.modified[part]=nil
    end)
    self.voidReturn=self.C.CFG.VOID_ENABLED and root.CFrame or nil
    self.voidPosition=root.Position
    self.propertiesDirty=true;self.nextScan=0;self.nextShot=0
    table.clear(self.angles);table.clear(self.timers)
end

local COMMON = {
    {"cfgDodge","predEnabled","pred"},{"antiBaitCFG","enabled","antiBait"},
    {"aaSettings","enabled","aa"},{"riotGodmodeCFG","enabled","rg"},
    {"riotAbuserCFG","enabled","ra"},{"slingCFG","enabled","sling"},
}

function Engine:_RefreshProperties()
    self.propertiesDirty=true
    if not self.character then return end
    local noclip,massless,hide=false,false,false
    for _,tuple in ipairs(COMMON) do
        local c=self.C[tuple[1]];local p=tuple[3]
        if c[tuple[2]] then
            noclip=noclip or c[p.."NoClip"] or c[p.."PhaseThrough"] or c[p.."IgnoreCollide"]
            massless=massless or c[p.."Massless"]
        end
    end
    noclip=noclip or self.C.cfg.orbitEnabled or self.C.CFG.VOID_ENABLED
    massless=massless or self.C.cfg.orbitEnabled
    noclip=false;massless=false
    local sling=self.C.slingCFG
    hide=false
    for part in pairs(self.parts) do
        if not part.Parent then self.parts[part]=nil;continue end
        local saved=self.modified[part]
        if not saved then saved={};self.modified[part]=saved end
        local function set(prop,enabled,value)
            if enabled then
                if saved[prop]==nil then saved[prop]=part[prop] end
                if part[prop]~=value then part[prop]=value end
            elseif saved[prop]~=nil then part[prop]=saved[prop];saved[prop]=nil end
        end
        set("CanCollide",noclip,false)
        set("Massless",massless,true)
        local accessory=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
        set("LocalTransparencyModifier",hide and (sling.hideAccessories or not accessory),sling.hideTransparency)
    end
    local shouldFace=false
    if self.humanoid and self.humanoid.Parent then
if shouldFace then self.humanoid.AutoRotate=false else self.humanoid.AutoRotate=self.originalAutoRotate end
end
    local wantsOwner=self.C.cfg.orbitEnabled and self.C.cfg.orbitNetworkOwn
    for _,tuple in ipairs(COMMON) do
        local c=self.C[tuple[1]]
        if c[tuple[2]] and (c[tuple[3].."NetworkOwn"] or (tuple[1]=="slingCFG" and c.noTpNetworkOwner)) then wantsOwner=true end
    end
    if wantsOwner and self.root and self.networkOwnerAttempted~=self.root then
        self.networkOwnerAttempted=self.root
        -- This API can be unavailable to a client; failure does not stop movement.
        pcall(function() self.root:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer) end)
    elseif not wantsOwner then self.networkOwnerAttempted=nil end
    if self.C.CFG.VOID_ENABLED then
        if self.originalDestroyHeight==nil then self.originalDestroyHeight=workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight end
        pcall(function() v112(workspace,"FallenPartsDestroyHeight",0/0) end)
    elseif self.originalDestroyHeight~=nil then
        local rage=self.context.HvhRagebot
        if not (rage and rage._enabled) then pcall(function() v112(workspace,"FallenPartsDestroyHeight",self.originalDestroyHeight) end) end
        self.originalDestroyHeight=nil
    end
    self.propertiesDirty=false
end

function Engine:_ClearEnemies()
    for _,entry in pairs(self.enemies) do clean(entry.connections) end
    table.clear(self.enemies)
    self.lockedTarget=nil
end

function Engine:_ScanEnemies()
    local fighters=self.context.HvhFighters
    local localState=fighters and fighters.LocalState
    local seen={}
    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player==LocalPlayer then continue end
        local state=fighters and fighters.StateByPlayer[player]
        if state and (not state.IsEnemy or (localState and state.EnvironmentId~=localState.EnvironmentId) or state:IsInvincible()) then continue end
        if not state and fighters then continue end
        local alive=state and state.Character.State
        local model=alive and alive.Alive and alive.Model or player.Character
        local root=model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or (alive and not alive.Alive) then continue end
        seen[player]=true
        local entry=self.enemies[player]
        if not entry or entry.model~=model then
            if entry then clean(entry.connections) end
            entry={player=player,model=model,root=root,hum=hum,state=state,connections={},tpTimes={},lastFire=-math.huge,lastPosition=root.Position}
            self.enemies[player]=entry
            local function shot() entry.lastFire=self.time end
            entry.watchedTools=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
            local function tool(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") and not entry.watchedTools[child] then
                    entry.watchedTools[child]=true
                    table.insert(entry.connections,child.Activated:Connect(shot))
                end
            end
            entry.watchTool=tool
            for _,child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do tool(child) end
            table.insert(entry.connections,model.ChildAdded:Connect(tool))
            table.insert(entry.connections,hum.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                local animation=track.Animation
                local name=(animation and animation.Name or track.Name):lower()
                if name:find("shoot",1,true) or name:find("fire",1,true) or name:find("attack",1,true)
                    or name:find("swing",1,true) or name:find("slash",1,true) then shot() end
            end))
        end
        if self.C.antiBaitCFG.enabled and self.time>=(entry.nextRescan or 0) then
            entry.nextRescan=self.time+self.C.antiBaitCFG.reScanInterval
            for _,child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do entry.watchTool(child) end
        end
        entry.alive=alive;entry.state=state
        entry.head=(alive and alive.HitboxHead) or model:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
        local eye=model:FindFirstChild("CameraBone",true)
        entry.eye=(eye and eye:IsA("BasePart") and eye) or model:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
        entry.distance=(root.Position-self.root.Position).Magnitude
    end
    for player,entry in pairs(self.enemies) do
        if not seen[player] then clean(entry.connections);self.enemies[player]=nil end
    end
end

function Engine:_Valid(entry)
    if not entry or not entry.model.Parent or not entry.root.Parent or entry.hum.Health<=0 then return false end
    if entry.state and (not entry.state.Character.State.Alive or not entry.state.IsEnemy or entry.state:IsInvincible()) then return false end
    local fighters=self.context.HvhFighters
    local own=fighters and fighters.LocalState
    if own and entry.state and own.EnvironmentId~=entry.state.EnvironmentId then return false end
    return true
end

function Engine:_Target(mode,lock)
    if lock and self:_Valid(self.lockedTarget) then return self.lockedTarget end
    local best,score=nil,math.huge
    local candidates={}
    for _,entry in pairs(self.enemies) do
        if not self:_Valid(entry) then continue end
        table.insert(candidates,entry)
        local s=(entry.root.Position-self.root.Position).Magnitude
        if mode=="Weakest" then s=entry.hum.Health elseif mode=="Strongest" then s=-entry.hum.Health end
        if s<score then score=s;best=entry end
    end
    if mode=="Random" and #candidates>0 then best=candidates[math.random(1,#candidates)] end
    if lock then self.lockedTarget=best end
    return best
end

function Engine:_Notify(text)
    if self.time<self.nextNotice then return end
    self.nextNotice=self.time+2
    pcall(function() tbl17.aB().get():Notify(text) end)
end

function Engine:_AimData(entry,position)
    local eye=entry.eye
    local origin=eye.Position
    local look=eye.CFrame.LookVector
    if entry.state then
        local ok,rotation=pcall(entry.state.GetCameraRotation,entry.state)
        if ok and typeof(rotation)=="Vector2" then
            look=(CFrame.fromOrientation(rotation.X,rotation.Y,0)).LookVector
        elseif ok and typeof(rotation)=="CFrame" then look=rotation.LookVector end
    end
    local to=position-origin
    local distance=to.Magnitude
    return distance>0.01 and look:Dot(to.Unit) or -1,distance,look,origin
end

function Engine:_ClearLine(origin,target,model)
    local params=RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.character,model}
    return workspace:Raycast(origin,target-origin,params)==nil
end

function Engine:_Dodge(entry,reason,distance,mode,cooldown,group)
    if self.time<(self.timers["dodge"..group] or 0) then return false end
    self.timers["dodge"..group]=self.time+math.max(cooldown,1/120)
    local away=unit(Vector3.new(self.root.Position.X-entry.root.Position.X,0,self.root.Position.Z-entry.root.Position.Z))
    local dir=away
    if mode=="Perpendicular" then dir=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X)*(math.random()<0.5 and -1 or 1)
    elseif mode=="Random" then local a=math.random()*TAU;dir=Vector3.new(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a)) end
    local pos=self.root.Position+dir*distance
    local c=self.C[group]
    local pred=group=="cfgDodge"
    if pred and c.predMultiPoint then pos=self.root.Position+dir*(distance*.7)+away*(distance*.5)+Vector3.new(0,math.random()*15,0) end
    if pred and c.predBackstep then pos+=away*(distance*.3) end
    local stick=pred and c.predStickToTarget or (not pred and c.antiBaitStickToTarget)
    local off=pred and c.predStickOffset or c.antiBaitStickOffset
    if stick then pos=entry.root.Position+away*math.max(off,1)+Vector3.new(0,self.root.Position.Y-entry.root.Position.Y,0) end
    local fast=pred and c.predFastTp or (not pred and c.antiBaitFastTp)
    local count=fast and (pred and c.predFastTpCount or c.antiBaitFastTpCount) or 1
    local interval=pred and c.predFastTpInterval or c.antiBaitFastTpInterval
    self.dodge={position=pos,entry=entry,group=group,remaining=math.clamp(count,1,100),next=self.time,
        interval=math.max(interval,1/120),expires=self.time+math.min(0.5,count*math.max(interval,1/120)+.03)}
    if (pred and (c.predNotifyAnywhere or (entry.root.Position-self.root.Position).Magnitude<500)) or (not pred and c.notifyOnDodge) then
        self:_Notify((pred and "Prediction: " or "Anti bait: ")..entry.player.Name.." ("..reason..")")
    end
    return true
end

function Engine:_Threats(dt)
    local p=self.C.cfgDodge;local b=self.C.antiBaitCFG
    if not p.predEnabled and not b.enabled then return end
    local position=self.root.Position
    local primary,score=nil,-math.huge
    for _,entry in pairs(self.enemies) do
        if not self:_Valid(entry) then continue end
        local dot,distance,look,origin=self:_AimData(entry,position)
        local velocity=entry.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if not validVector(velocity) then velocity=ZERO end
        local toward=unit(position-origin)
        local velDot=velocity.Magnitude>1 and velocity.Unit:Dot(toward) or 0
        local s=p.predThreatScore and (math.max(0,dot)*45+math.max(0,velDot)*20+math.max(0,1-distance/250)*30) or -distance
        if s>score then primary={entry=entry,dot=dot,distance=distance,look=look,origin=origin,velocity=velocity,velDot=velDot};score=s end
        if b.enabled and distance<=(b.infiniteRange and b.infiniteRadius or 500) then
            local fired=self.time-entry.lastFire<=b.baitReactionWindow
            local trigger,reason,dist=false,"",b.velDodgeDist
            if b.dodgeOnShoot and fired then trigger=true;reason="shot" end
            if b.gunPredEnabled and dot>b.gunPredDot then
                local future=position+self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity*b.gunPredLead-(origin+velocity*b.gunPredLead)
                if future.Magnitude>.001 and look:Dot(future.Unit)>b.gunPredDot then trigger=true;reason="predicted shot";dist=b.gunPredDodgeDist end
            end
            if b.antiBaitUniversalAim and dot>b.gunPredDot then trigger=true;reason="aim" end
            if b.antiBaitUniversalAnimation and self.time-entry.lastFire<=.1 then trigger=true;reason="animation" end
            if b.velSpikeEnabled and b.antiBaitUniversalVelocity and velocity.Magnitude>b.velThreshold and velDot>.6 then trigger=true;reason="velocity spike" end
            if entry.lastPosition and b.flickerEnabled and (entry.root.Position-entry.lastPosition).Magnitude>b.flickerTpDist then table.insert(entry.tpTimes,self.time) end
            for i=#entry.tpTimes,1,-1 do if self.time-entry.tpTimes[i]>b.flickerWindow then table.remove(entry.tpTimes,i) end end
            if b.flickerEnabled and #entry.tpTimes>=b.flickerMinTps then trigger=true;reason="flicker";table.clear(entry.tpTimes) end
            if b.baitEnabled and b.baitHookActivate and fired and self.time>=(entry.nextBait or 0) then
                entry.nextBait=self.time+b.baitReactionWindow
                entry.pendingBait=self.time+b.baitFakeLockTime+(math.random()<b.baitStallChance and b.baitStallTime or 0)
                if b.baitNotifyLabel then self:_Notify("Bait confirmed: "..entry.player.Name) end
            end
            if entry.pendingBait and self.time>=entry.pendingBait then entry.pendingBait=nil;trigger=true;reason="bait counter" end
            if trigger then self:_Dodge(entry,reason,dist,b.dodgeMode,reason=="predicted shot" and b.gunPredCooldown or b.dodgeCooldown,"antiBaitCFG") end
        end
        entry.lastPosition=entry.root.Position
    end
    if not p.predEnabled or not primary then return end
    local t=primary
    if not p.predInfiniteRange and t.distance>p.predRadius then return end
    local fired=p.predShootDetect and self.time-t.entry.lastFire<=p.predReactTime
    local threat=fired or t.dot>p.predShootDot or (t.velDot>.7 and t.velocity.Magnitude>p.predThreshold)
    if p.predRaycast and t.dot>.6 and self:_ClearLine(t.origin,position,t.entry.model) then threat=true end
    if p.predPredictiveAim then
        local future=position+self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity*p.predPredictiveLead-(t.origin+t.velocity*p.predPredictiveLead)
        if future.Magnitude>.01 and t.look:Dot(future.Unit)>.85 then threat=true end
    end
    if p.predAnimDetect and self.time-t.entry.lastFire<=.1 then threat=true end
    if not threat then return end
    local lead=math.min(t.distance/math.max(p.predBulletSpd,1),p.predLeadTime)*p.predMult
    local distance=(fired and p.predShootDist or p.predDodgeDist)+math.min(lead*math.max(0,t.velocity.Magnitude-p.predThreshold),p.predDodgeDist)
    local cooldown=p.predCooldown
    if p.predReactionLadder then
        local rung=self.time-(self.lastPrediction or 0)<1.5 and math.min((self.predRung or 0)+1,5) or 0
        self.predRung=rung;cooldown/=1+rung*.5
    end
    if self:_Dodge(t.entry,fired and "shot" or "threat",distance,"Perpendicular",cooldown,"cfgDodge") then self.lastPrediction=self.time end
end

function Engine:_Void(dt,target)
    local c=self.C.CFG
    self.angles.CFG=(self.angles.CFG or 0)+dt
    local t=self.angles.CFG
    local base=Vector3.new(c.BASE_X,c.BASE_Y,c.BASE_Z)
    local radius=math.min(c.RADIUS,1e24)
    local yMin,yMax=math.min(c.VOID_Y_MIN,c.VOID_Y_MAX),math.max(c.VOID_Y_MIN,c.VOID_Y_MAX)
    local method=c.VOID_METHOD
    local pos
    if method=="Drift" then pos=(self.voidPosition or self.root.Position)+Vector3.new(1,.5,.3)*(c.SPEED*dt)
    elseif method=="Chaos" then pos=(self.voidPosition or base)+Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5)*(c.SPEED*dt*5*c.CHAOS)
    elseif method=="Loop" then local r=math.min(radius*.8,1e9+(t%100)*1e7);pos=base+Vector3.new(math.cos(t*2)*r,(yMin+yMax)*.5+math.sin(t*1.3)*r,math.sin(t*2)*r)
    elseif method=="Spiral" then local r=math.min(radius*.9,(t%50)*2e9);pos=base+Vector3.new(math.cos(t*3)*r,math.sin(t*.7)*r,math.sin(t*3)*r)
    elseif method=="OrbitTarget" and target then pos=target.root.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(t*math.pi/2)*5,2,math.sin(t*math.pi/2)*5)
    elseif method=="TP Everywhere" then
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            local v=camera.ViewportSize
            local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(math.random()*math.max(1,v.X),math.random()*math.max(1,v.Y))
            pos=ray.Origin+ray.Direction*randomBetween(-radius,radius)
        else pos=base end
    else
        local jump=base+Vector3.new(randomBetween(-radius,radius),randomBetween(yMin,yMax),randomBetween(-radius,radius))
        pos=(self.voidPosition or base):Lerp(jump,c.CHAOS)
    end
    if validVector(pos) then self.voidPosition=pos;return CFrame.new(pos) end
    return nil
end

function Engine:_Orbit(dt,target)
    if not target then self.followPosition=nil;return nil end
    local c=self.C.cfg
    local a=(self.angles.cfg or 0)+math.rad(c.orbitSpeed)*dt*(c.orbitReverse and -1 or 1)
    self.angles.cfg=a%TAU
    local r=c.orbitDist
    if c.orbitRandRad then
        if self.time>=(self.timers.orbitRadius or 0) then self.timers.orbitRadius=self.time+.25;self.randomRadius=randomBetween(c.orbitRandMin,c.orbitRandMax) end
        r=self.randomRadius or r
    end
    local x,z=math.cos(a)*r,math.sin(a)*r
    local mode=c.orbitMode
    if mode=="Figure 8" then x=math.sin(a)*r;z=math.sin(2*a)*r*.5
    elseif mode=="Ellipse" then z*=.5
    elseif mode=="Spiral In" then r=math.max(1,r*(1-(self.time%5)/5));x=math.cos(a)*r;z=math.sin(a)*r
    elseif mode=="Spiral Out" then r*=.1+(self.time%5)/5;x=math.cos(a)*r;z=math.sin(a)*r
    elseif mode=="Bounce" then x=math.sin(a)*r;z=math.abs(math.cos(a))*r
    elseif mode=="Lemniscate" or mode=="Infinity" then local d=1+math.sin(a)^2;x=r*math.cos(a)/d;z=r*math.sin(a)*math.cos(a)/d
    elseif mode=="RandomOrbit" then
        if self.time>=(self.timers.orbitRandom or 0) then self.timers.orbitRandom=self.time+.1;self.randomOrbit=Vector3.new(randomBetween(-r,r),0,randomBetween(-r,r)) end
        x=self.randomOrbit.X;z=self.randomOrbit.Z
    end
    local offset=Vector3.new(x,c.orbitHeight,z)
    if c.orbitAxis=="XY" then offset=Vector3.new(x,z+c.orbitHeight,0)
    elseif c.orbitAxis=="YZ" then offset=Vector3.new(0,x+c.orbitHeight,z) end
    local desired=target.root.Position+offset+Vector3.new(c.orbitOffX,0,c.orbitOffZ)
    local from=self.networkPose and self.networkPose.Position or self.root.Position
    local position=from:Lerp(desired,alpha(c.orbitLerp,dt))
    self:_RequestFire(target,c.orbitShootCooldown,c.orbitAttackRange,true)
    return face(position,target.root.Position)
end

function Engine:_Sling(dt,target)
    local c=self.C.slingCFG
    if not target then self.followPosition=nil;return nil end
    if c.noTpMode then
        if c.noTpAutoShoot and (target.root.Position-self.root.Position).Magnitude<=c.noTpRange then
            self:_RequestFire(target,c.shotCooldown,c.noTpInfiniteRange and c.noTpWeaponRange or c.noTpRange,c.noTpAimAssist)
        end
        return nil
    end
    local root=target.root
    local position=root.Position
    if c.followPredict then position+=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity*c.followLead end
    local desired
    if c.mode=="Follow" then desired=position-root.CFrame.LookVector*c.followDistance+Vector3.new(0,c.followHeight,0)
    elseif c.mode=="Stalk" then desired=position+root.CFrame.LookVector*c.stalkDistance*(c.stalkBehind and -1 or 1)+Vector3.new(0,c.stalkHeight,0)
    elseif c.mode=="Hover" then desired=position+Vector3.new(0,c.hoverHeight+(c.hoverBob and math.sin(self.time*c.hoverBobSpeed*TAU)*c.hoverBobAmp or 0),0)
    elseif c.mode=="OrbitTarget" then
        local a=(self.angles.slingCFG or 0)+math.rad(c.orbitSpeed)*dt;self.angles.slingCFG=a%TAU
        desired=position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*c.orbitRadius,c.orbitHeight,math.sin(a)*c.orbitRadius)
    elseif c.mode=="RandomAroundTarget" then
        if self.time>=(self.timers.slingRandom or 0) then local a=math.random()*TAU;self.timers.slingRandom=self.time+.05;self.slingRandom=Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*c.randomRadius,c.stickHeight,math.sin(a)*c.randomRadius) end
        desired=position+self.slingRandom
    elseif c.mode=="FastTp" then
        if self.time>=(self.timers.slingRush or 0) then
            local a=c.fastTpRandAng and math.random()*TAU or 0
            self.slingRushOffset=Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*c.fastTpOffset+randomBetween(-c.fastTpJitter,c.fastTpJitter),c.stickHeight,math.sin(a)*c.fastTpOffset+randomBetween(-c.fastTpJitter,c.fastTpJitter))
            self.timers.slingRush=self.time+math.max(c.rushCooldown,c.fastTpSpeed)
            self.slingBurstRemaining=c.fastTpMulti and c.fastTpCount or 1
        end
        desired=position+(self.slingRushOffset or Vector3.new(0,c.stickHeight,0))
        if c.fastTpPenetrate and (self.slingBurstRemaining or 0)<=0 then desired=self.root.Position end
        self.slingBurstRemaining=math.max(0,(self.slingBurstRemaining or 0)-1)
    else desired=position+Vector3.new(0,c.stickHeight,0) end
    local smooth=(c.mode=="Follow" or c.mode=="Stalk" or c.mode=="Hover") and alpha(c.followLerp,dt) or 1
    self.followPosition=(self.followPosition or self.root.Position):Lerp(desired,smooth)
    if c.useTargetVel then self.desiredVelocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end
    if c.autoShoot then self:_RequestFire(target,c.shotCooldown,c.attackRange,true) end
    return face(self.followPosition,target.root.Position)
end

function Engine:_RiotAbuser(dt,target)
    if not target then return nil end
    local c=self.C.riotAbuserCFG
    local position=target.root.Position+(c.predictTarget and target.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity*c.predictLead or ZERO)
    local offset=Vector3.new(c.right,c.height-c.down,-c.forward)
    if c.mode=="Bounce" then offset+=Vector3.new(0,math.sin(self.time*c.bounceSpeed)*c.bounceHeight,0)
    elseif c.mode=="Orbit" or c.orbitEnabled then
        local a=math.rad(c.orbitSpeed)*self.time
        offset+=Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*c.orbitRadius,c.orbitHeight,math.sin(a)*c.orbitRadius)
    elseif c.mode=="Phase" then offset+=Vector3.new(0,0,math.sin(self.time*20)*c.phaseOffset) end
    if c.randomOffset then offset+=Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5)*c.randomOffAmp*2 end
    local moved=position+target.root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(offset)
    local cf=c.forceFaceTarget and face(moved,position) or (CFrame.new(moved)*self.root.CFrame.Rotation)
    if c.spinOnTarget then cf*=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(c.spinSpeed)*self.time,0) end
    if c.autoShoot then self:_RequestFire(target,c.shootCooldown,c.attackRange,c.raAutoShootAccurate) end
    return cf
end

function Engine:_RiotGodmode(dt,target)
    local c=self.C.riotGodmodeCFG
    if self.time<(self.timers.riotMove or 0) then return nil end
    local interval=c.phaseMode and c.phaseInterval or c.speed
    if c.multiTp then interval=math.max(c.multiTpDelay,c.speed/math.max(1,c.multiTpCount)) end
    self.timers.riotMove=self.time+math.max(interval,1/120)
    local a=math.random()*TAU;local distance=randomBetween(c.minJump,c.maxJump)
    if c.avoidBullets and target and (target.root.Position-self.root.Position).Magnitude<c.evadeRange then distance=math.max(distance,c.bulletDodge) end
    local from=self.networkPose and self.networkPose.Position or self.root.Position
    local position=from+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*distance,randomBetween(-c.heightVariance,c.heightVariance),math.sin(a)*distance)
    if c.groundSnap then
        local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;params.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.character}
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(position+Vector3.new(0,100,0),Vector3.new(0,-400,0),params)
        if hit then position=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0) end
    end
    local spin=math.rad(c.spinSpeed)*self.time
    local axis=c.randomAxis and ({"X","Y","Z"})[math.random(1,3)] or c.spinAxis
    local cf=target and face(position,target.root.Position) or CFrame.new(position)
    cf*=CFrame.Angles(axis=="X" and spin or 0,axis=="Y" and spin or 0,axis=="Z" and spin or 0)
    if c.autoShoot then self:_RequestFire(target,c.shootCooldown,c.attackRange,c.rgAutoShootAccurate) end
    return cf
end

function Engine:_ResolveTranslocBaseCF(realCF)
    if typeof(realCF) == "CFrame" then return realCF end
    if typeof(self.translocRealCF) == "CFrame" then return self.translocRealCF end
    local root = self.root or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if root and typeof(root.CFrame) == "CFrame" then return root.CFrame end
    return CFrame.identity
end

function Engine:_GetTranslocFakePos(realCF, index)
    realCF = self:_ResolveTranslocBaseCF(realCF)
    local translocCFG = self.C.translocCFG
    local d = (translocCFG.rivalsMode and translocCFG.rivalsTranslocDist) or translocCFG.offsetDist
    local jmp = translocCFG.jitter and translocCFG.jitterAmp or 0
    local base = realCF.Position
    if not validVector(base) then base = Vector3.zero; realCF = CFrame.identity end
    local ox, oy, oz = 0, 0, 0
    local m = translocCFG.offsetMode
    self.translocWaveT = self.translocWaveT or 0
    self.translocPingPongDir = self.translocPingPongDir or 1
    self.translocAltVert = self.translocAltVert or 1
    self.translocPulseT = self.translocPulseT or 0

    if translocCFG.wavePattern then
        self.translocWaveT = self.translocWaveT + 0.01
        d = d + math.sin(self.translocWaveT * translocCFG.waveFreq * 2 * math.pi) * translocCFG.waveAmp
    end
    if translocCFG.pingPong then
        local ppDist = translocCFG.pingPongDist or d
        d = ppDist * self.translocPingPongDir
    end
    if translocCFG.cascadeOffset and index then
        d = d + (index - 1) * translocCFG.cascadeStep
    end
    if translocCFG.pulse then
        self.translocPulseT = self.translocPulseT + 0.01
        d = d + math.sin(self.translocPulseT * translocCFG.pulseSpeed * 2 * math.pi) * translocCFG.pulseAmp
    end

    -- Stick to target override if enabled and valid target exists
    if translocCFG.translocStickToTarget then
        local target = self:_Target("Closest")
        if target and target.root and validVector(target.root.Position) then
            base = target.root.Position - target.root.CFrame.LookVector * (translocCFG.translocStickOffset or 2)
        end
    end

    if m == "Ahead" then
        local look = realCF.LookVector; ox = look.X * d; oz = look.Z * d; oy = translocCFG.offsetY
    elseif m == "Behind" then
        local look = realCF.LookVector; ox = -look.X * d; oz = -look.Z * d; oy = translocCFG.offsetY
    elseif m == "Perpendicular" then
        local right = realCF.RightVector
        local side = math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1
        ox = right.X * d * side; oz = right.Z * d * side; oy = translocCFG.offsetY
    elseif m == "Above" then
        ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp; oy = math.abs(d) + translocCFG.offsetY; oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
    elseif m == "Below" then
        ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp; oy = -math.abs(d) + translocCFG.offsetY; oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
    elseif m == "AboveBelow" then
        self.translocAltVert = -self.translocAltVert
        ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
        oy = self.translocAltVert * (math.abs(d) + translocCFG.altVertAmp) + translocCFG.offsetY
        oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
    elseif m == "MirrorX" then
        ox = -base.X * 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp; oy = translocCFG.offsetY; oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
    elseif m == "MirrorZ" then
        ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp; oy = translocCFG.offsetY; oz = -base.Z * 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
    elseif m == "Diagonal" then
        local ang = math.rad(translocCFG.diagonalAngle)
        ox = math.cos(ang) * d; oz = math.sin(ang) * d; oy = translocCFG.offsetY
    elseif m == "ScreenEdge" then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            local corners = { Vector2.new(0,0), Vector2.new(vp.X,0), Vector2.new(0,vp.Y), Vector2.new(vp.X,vp.Y) }
            local c = corners[math.random(1, 4)]
            local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(c.X, c.Y, math.clamp(math.abs(d), 1, 1e9))
            if validVector(ray.Origin) then
                return CFrame.new(ray.Origin)
            end
        end
    elseif m == "Orbit" then
        self.translocWaveT = self.translocWaveT + 0.02
        local ang = self.translocWaveT * math.rad(translocCFG.orbitSpeed)
        ox = math.cos(ang) * translocCFG.orbitRadius
        oz = math.sin(ang) * translocCFG.orbitRadius
        oy = translocCFG.offsetY
    elseif m == "ZoneEscape" then
        local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5)
        if dir.Magnitude > 0.001 then dir = dir.Unit else dir = Vector3.xAxis end
        return CFrame.new(base + dir * translocCFG.zoneEscapeRadius)
    end

    -- Additive pattern toggles (can layer on top of any Offset Mode)
    if translocCFG.diagonal and m ~= "Diagonal" then
        local ang = math.rad(translocCFG.diagonalAngle)
        ox = ox + math.cos(ang) * (d * 0.5)
        oz = oz + math.sin(ang) * (d * 0.5)
    end
    if translocCFG.alternatingVertical and m ~= "AboveBelow" then
        self.translocAltVert = -self.translocAltVert
        oy = oy + self.translocAltVert * translocCFG.altVertAmp
    end
    if translocCFG.orbitFake and m ~= "Orbit" then
        self.translocWaveT = self.translocWaveT + 0.02
        local ang = self.translocWaveT * math.rad(translocCFG.orbitSpeed)
        ox = ox + math.cos(ang) * translocCFG.orbitRadius
        oz = oz + math.sin(ang) * translocCFG.orbitRadius
    end
    if translocCFG.mirrorX and m ~= "MirrorX" then
        ox = -ox
    end
    if translocCFG.mirrorZ and m ~= "MirrorZ" then
        oz = -oz
    end
    if translocCFG.jitter and m ~= "Above" and m ~= "Below" and m ~= "AboveBelow" then
        ox = ox + (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
        oz = oz + (math.random() - 0.5) * jmp
    end
    if translocCFG.spinFake then
        local spinAng = tick() * math.rad(translocCFG.spinFakeSpeed)
        local nx = ox * math.cos(spinAng) - oz * math.sin(spinAng)
        local nz = ox * math.sin(spinAng) + oz * math.cos(spinAng)
        ox = nx; oz = nz
    end

    local finalPos = Vector3.new(
        math.clamp(base.X + ox, -1e18, 1e18),
        math.clamp(base.Y + oy, -1e18, 1e18),
        math.clamp(base.Z + oz, -1e18, 1e18)
    )
    if not validVector(finalPos) then return realCF end
    if translocCFG.spinFake then
        local spinAng = tick() * math.rad(translocCFG.spinFakeSpeed)
        return CFrame.new(finalPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinAng, 0)
    end
    return CFrame.new(finalPos) * realCF.Rotation
end

function Engine:_StartTranslocCore()
    self:_StopTranslocCore()
    self.translocPingPongDir=1;self.translocWaveT=0;self.translocAltVert=1
    self.translocPulseT=0;self.translocPhase=0;self.translocPingPongTimer=0
    -- Step publishes only owned network poses. The shared controller restores the
    -- visible body before camera rendering and before local physics simulation.
end

function Engine:_StopTranslocCore()
    if self.translocConn then self.translocConn:Disconnect(); self.translocConn = nil end
    if self.translocPreRender then self.translocPreRender:Disconnect(); self.translocPreRender = nil end
    self.translocRealCF = nil
    self.translocBurstLock = false
end

function Engine:_Translocation(base,dt)
    base = self:_ResolveTranslocBaseCF(base)
    local c=self.C.translocCFG
    self.translocPingPongTimer=(self.translocPingPongTimer or 0)+dt
    if c.pingPong and self.translocPingPongTimer>.5 then
        self.translocPingPongTimer=0;self.translocPingPongDir=-(self.translocPingPongDir or 1)
    end
    if c.autoDodge then
        local enemy=self:_Target("Closest")
        if enemy then
            local delta=base.Position-enemy.root.Position
            if delta.Magnitude<c.autoDodgeRadius then
                base=CFrame.new(base.Position+unit(delta)*60)*base.Rotation
            end
        end
    end
    local frequency = c.rivalsMode and c.rivalsTranslocFreq or c.frequency
    if c.randomFrequency then
        if self.time>=(self.timers.translocFreq or 0) then self.timers.translocFreq=self.time+.1;self.translocFrequency=randomBetween(c.freqMin,c.freqMax) end
        frequency=self.translocFrequency or frequency
    end
    self.translocPhase=(self.translocPhase or 0)+dt*frequency
    local layers=math.max(1, c.rivalsMode and c.rivalsTranslocLayers or c.layers)
    local layer=math.floor(self.translocPhase)%layers+1
    if c.burstMode then
        layer=(math.floor(self.time/math.max(c.burstInterval,1/120))%math.max(1,c.burstCount))%layers+1
    end
    local target = self:_Target("Closest")
    if c.translocAutoShoot and target then
        local shootRange = c.translocInfiniteRange and 1e15 or c.translocAutoShootRange
        self:_RequestFire(target, 0.01, shootRange, c.translocAutoAim)
    end
    return self:_GetTranslocFakePos(base, layer)
end

function Engine:_AntiAim(base,dt)
    local c=self.C.aaSettings
    local speed=c.speed
    if c.randomSpeed then
        if self.time>=(self.timers.aaSpeed or 0) then self.timers.aaSpeed=self.time+.1;self.aaSpeed=.2+math.random()*.8 end
        speed*=self.aaSpeed or 1
    end
    self.angles.aaSettings=((self.angles.aaSettings or 0)+speed*dt)%360
    local pitch,yaw,roll=0,self.angles.aaSettings,0
    if c.mode=="Jitter" then local sign=math.floor(self.time*30)%2==0 and 1 or -1;pitch=c.jitterPitch and c.pitchAngle*sign or 0;yaw=c.jitterYaw and c.yawAngle*sign or 0
    elseif c.mode=="Static" then pitch=c.staticPitch;yaw=c.staticYaw
    elseif c.mode=="Up" then pitch=90;yaw=0
    elseif c.mode=="Down" then pitch=-90;yaw=0
    elseif c.mode=="Side" then pitch=0;yaw=0;roll=90
    elseif c.mode=="Custom" then pitch=c.customPitch;yaw=c.customYaw
    elseif c.mode=="RandomSpin" then pitch=c.customPitch;yaw*=math.random()*2-1 end
    if c.fakeAngle then yaw+=c.fakeYaw;pitch+=c.fakePitch end
    if c.microJitter then yaw+=math.sin(self.time*c.microJitterSpeed)*c.microJitterAmp end
    if c.breatheEffect then pitch+=math.sin(self.time*c.breatheSpeed*TAU)*c.breatheAmp end
    if c.desyncMode then yaw+=c.desyncOffset end
    if c.rollEnabled then roll+=self.time*c.rollSpeed end
    if c.randomFlip and math.random()<1-(1-c.flipChance)^(dt*60) then yaw+=180 end
    if c.enhancedMode then
        if c.multiAxisSpin then
            pitch+=c.multiAxisX and self.time*c.multiAxisSpeedX or 0
            yaw+=c.multiAxisY and self.time*c.multiAxisSpeedY or 0
            roll+=c.multiAxisZ and self.time*c.multiAxisSpeedZ or 0
        end
        if c.chaosMode then
            if self.time>=(self.timers.aaChaos or 0) then self.timers.aaChaos=self.time+c.chaosInterval;self.aaChaos=Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5)*c.chaosMaxAngle*2 end
            local chaos=self.aaChaos or ZERO;pitch+=chaos.X;yaw+=chaos.Y;roll+=chaos.Z
        end
        if c.lookAtRandom then
            if self.time>=(self.timers.aaLook or 0) then self.timers.aaLook=self.time+c.lookAtRandomInterval;self.aaLook=randomBetween(-180,180) end
            yaw+=self.aaLook or 0
        end
    end
    local cf=CFrame.new(base.Position)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch%360),math.rad(yaw%360),math.rad(roll%360))
    return cf
end

function Engine:_RequestFire(entry,cooldown,range,aim)
    if not self:_Valid(entry) or (entry.root.Position-self.root.Position).Magnitude>range then return end
    if not self.fireRequest then self.fireRequest={entry=entry,cooldown=cooldown,aim=aim} end
end

function Engine:_Fire(request)
    if not request or self.time<self.nextShot or not self:_Valid(request.entry) then return end
    local rage=self.context.HvhRagebot
    if rage and rage._enabled then return end
    local inner=self:_Inner()
    if not inner or not inner.FighterState.Character.State.Alive or inner.FighterState.IsSpectating or inner.FighterState.EnvironmentId==nil then return end
    local item=inner.ItemBehaviors:GetEquipped()
    if not item or (item.__type~="Gun" and item.__type~="Melee") then return end
    local equipUntil=item.Inner and v102(item.Inner,"_equip_cooldown")
    if not item:IsEquipped() or (finite(equipUntil) and tick()<equipUntil) then return end
    local entry=request.entry
    local target={FighterState=entry.state,AliveState=entry.state and entry.state.Character.State or entry.alive}
    if not Shot.Target(target) then return end
    if item.__type=="Gun" then
        local untilTime=item.Inner and v102(item.Inner,"_shoot_cooldown")
        if item:IsReloading() or (finite(untilTime) and tick()<untilTime) then return end
        if item:GetExpectedAmmoAfterPendingShots()<=0 then
            if self.time>=(self.nextReload or 0) then self.nextReload=self.time+.4;item:Reload() end
            return
        end
    end
    local sling=self.C.slingCFG
    local noTp=sling.enabled and sling.noTpMode
    local controller=inner.CharacterController
    if not noTp then
        self.shotParams=self.shotParams or RaycastParams.new()
        self.shotParams.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local pose=Shot.Pose(target,item,self.root,controller,item.__type=="Melee",self.shotParams)
        if not pose then return end
        controller:SetServerCFrame(pose,"CloudyHvHShot",15)
    end
    controller:HeartbeatUpdate()
    local frame,hit=Shot.Aim(controller,self.root,item,target)
    if not frame then return end
    local origin=frame.Position
    local part=target.AliveState.HitboxHead
    if noTp and (part.Position-origin).Magnitude>sling.noTpWeaponRange then return end
    local heavy=item.__type=="Melee" and item.Name=="Knife" and type(item.HeavyAttack)=="function"
    if item.__type=="Gun" then item:ShootAt(frame,frame,hit)
    else
        local info=item._info or {}
        local reach=info.Range or info.AttackRange or 12
        if not hit or (part.Position-origin).Magnitude>reach then return end
        if heavy then item:HeavyAttack(frame,frame,hit) else item:Attack(frame,frame,hit) end
    end
    self.nextShot=self.time+math.max(request.cooldown or .01,Shot.Cooldown(item,heavy))
    if request.aim or (noTp and sling.noTpLookVector) then
        local pitch,yaw=frame:ToOrientation()
        controller:SendViewAngles(25,{Kind="Normalized",Pitch=math.deg(pitch),Yaw=math.deg(yaw)})
        self.viewApplied=true
    end
end

function Engine:_Expand(target)
    local s=self.C.slingCFG;local p=self.C.cfgDodge
    local size=s.enabled and s.noTpMode and s.noTpHitboxSize or (p.predEnabled and p.predRivalsHitboxExpand and p.predRivalsHitboxSize or nil)
    if not size or not target or not self:_Valid(target) then self:_RestoreExpanded();return end
    local part=target.head
    for previous,saved in pairs(self.expanded) do
        if previous~=part then if previous.Parent then for prop,v in pairs(saved) do write(previous,prop,v) end end;self.expanded[previous]=nil end
    end
    if not self.expanded[part] then Shot.RememberSize(part,part.Size);self.expanded[part]={Size=part.Size,CanCollide=part.CanCollide,Massless=part.Massless} end
    local desired=Vector3.new(size,size,size)
    if part.Size~=desired then part.Size=desired;part.CanCollide=false;part.Massless=true end
end

function Engine:_ApplyMovementVelocity(moved)
    local inner=self:_Inner()
    if not inner then return end
    local zero=self.C.CFG.VOID_ENABLED or self.C.cfg.orbitEnabled
    for _,tuple in ipairs(COMMON) do
        local c=self.C[tuple[1]]
        if c[tuple[2]] then zero=zero or c[tuple[3].."VelZero"] end
    end
    local linear=moved and validVector(self.desiredVelocity) and self.desiredVelocity or (moved and zero and ZERO or nil)
    inner.CharacterController:SetServerVelocity(linear,moved and zero and ZERO or nil,"CloudyHvH")
end

function Engine:Step(dt)
    if self.destroyed or not self.active then return end
    dt=math.clamp(finite(dt) and dt or 1/60,1/1000,.1)
    self.time+=dt
    local char,root,hum=self:_Local()
    if not char then
        if self.character then self:_ResetCharacter();self:_ClearEnemies() end
        return
    end
    if char~=self.character then self:_BindCharacter(char,root,hum) end
    if self.propertiesDirty or self.time>=(self.nextProperties or 0) then self:_RefreshProperties();self.nextProperties=self.time+.2 end
    if self.time>=self.nextScan then self:_ScanEnemies();self.nextScan=self.time+.15 end
    self.fireRequest=nil
    self.desiredVelocity=nil
    local inner=self:_Inner()
    if inner and self.viewApplied then inner.CharacterController:SendViewAngles(25,nil);self.viewApplied=false end
    local target=self:_Target(self.C.slingCFG.enabled and self.C.slingCFG.targetMode or "Closest",self.C.slingCFG.enabled and self.C.slingCFG.noTpTargetLock)
    local desired
    if self.C.CFG.VOID_ENABLED then desired=self:_Void(dt,target)
    elseif self.C.cfg.orbitEnabled then desired=self:_Orbit(dt,self:_Target(self.C.cfg.orbitTarget))
    elseif self.C.slingCFG.enabled and not self.C.slingCFG.noTpMode then desired=self:_Sling(dt,target)
    elseif self.C.riotAbuserCFG.enabled then desired=self:_RiotAbuser(dt,self.C.riotAbuserCFG.multiTarget and self:_Target("Random") or target)
    elseif self.C.riotGodmodeCFG.enabled then desired=self:_RiotGodmode(dt,target) end
    if self.C.slingCFG.enabled and self.C.slingCFG.noTpMode then self:_Sling(dt,target) end
    if self.time>=self.nextThreat then self:_Threats(self.time-(self.lastThreatTime or 0));self.lastThreatTime=self.time;self.nextThreat=self.time+1/30 end
    local dodge=self.dodge
    if dodge and (self.time>dodge.expires or not self:_Valid(dodge.entry)) then self.dodge=nil;dodge=nil end
    if dodge and self.time>=dodge.next and dodge.remaining>0 then
        dodge.next=self.time+dodge.interval;dodge.remaining-=1
        desired=face(dodge.position,dodge.entry.root.Position)
        local c=self.C[dodge.group]
        local pred=dodge.group=="cfgDodge"
        if (pred and c.predAutoShoot) or (not pred and c.antiBaitAutoShoot) then
            self:_RequestFire(dodge.entry,.01,pred and c.predAutoShootRange or c.antiBaitAutoShootRange,pred and c.predAutoAim or c.antiBaitAutoAim)
        end
    end
    local moved=desired~=nil and validCF(desired)
    if self.positioningActive~=moved then
        self.positioningActive=moved;self:_RefreshProperties()
    end
    if moved then self.networkPose=desired
    elseif not self.C.riotGodmodeCFG.enabled then self.networkPose=nil end
    self:_ApplyMovementVelocity(moved)
    if inner then
        local fake=self.networkPose or inner.CharacterController:GetClientCFrame() or root.CFrame
        inner.CharacterController:SetServerCFrame(nil,"CloudyHvHShot")
        if self.C.translocCFG.enabled then
            fake=self:_Translocation(fake,dt)
            if self.C.translocCFG.fakeVel then
                local mag = math.min(self.C.translocCFG.fakeVelMag, 1e15)
                local fv = Vector3.new((math.random()-0.5)*mag*2, (math.random()-0.5)*mag*2, (math.random()-0.5)*mag*2)
                if validVector(fv) then
                    inner.CharacterController:SetServerVelocity(fv, Vector3.zero, "CloudyHvH")
                end
            end
        end
        if self.C.aaSettings.enabled then fake=self:_AntiAim(fake,dt) end
        if (self.networkPose or self.C.translocCFG.enabled or self.C.aaSettings.enabled) and validCF(fake) then
            inner.CharacterController:SetServerCFrame(fake,"CloudyHvH",10);self.fakeApplied=true
        else self:_ClearFake() end
    end
    self:_Expand(target)
    self:_Fire(self.fireRequest)
end

function Engine:Destroy()
    if self.destroyed then return end
    self.destroyed=true;self.active=false
    self:_StopTranslocCore()
    self:_ResetCharacter();self:_ClearEnemies();clean(self.connections)
end
Engine.Math={finite=finite,validVector=validVector,validCF=validCF,alpha=alpha,randomBetween=randomBetween,normalized=normalized}
return Engine

end
tbl17.kM=function()
 local cached=tbl17.cache.kM
 if not cached then cached={c=fn35()};tbl17.cache.kM=cached end
 return cached.c
end

do -- kN
local function fn35()
local Spec = tbl17.kL()
local Runtime = tbl17.kM()
local UI = {}

function UI.Build(context, rootTab)
    local adapter = context.ReactiveStoreAdapter
    local engine = Runtime.new(context)
    context.HvhOwner:Add(engine)
    context.HvhBindRuntime(engine)
    local pages = {}

        Translocation="rbxassetid://6034509993", SlingBypass="rbxassetid://6034509993", Riot="rbxassetid://6034684949"}

                    Active=bindPath("State"),ShowInList=bindPath("ShowInList"),Invisible=bindPath("Invisible")}})

            elseif c.Kind == "Slider" then
                section:AddSlider({Label=label,Default=c.Default,Min=c.Min,Max=c.Max,Step=c.Step,Config=path})
            else
                section:AddDropdown({Label=label,Default=c.Default,Options=c.Options,Config=path})
            end

    end
    local function sync() engine:Sync(adapter:Get({"HvH"})) end
    context.HvhOwner:Add(adapter:Changed({"HvH"},true):Connect(sync))
    sync()
    return engine

return UI
