        emitter("AngelicLeftWing",CFrame.new(-1.012,.5,.852)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(15),0),"13267054240",wing)
        wing.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Front
        emitter("AngelicRightWing",CFrame.new(1.167,.5,.852)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(-15),0),"13267054240",wing)
        emitter("AngelicBloom",CFrame.new(0,.3,0),"11402221943",{Rate=5,Lifetime=NumberRange.new(2),
            FlipbookLayout=Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4,FlipbookMode=Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot,
            SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Speed=NumberRange.new(.5),Size=NumberSequence.new(3,4),
            Transparency=sequence({{0,1},{.5,.3},{1,1}})})
    elseif effect=="Ambient" then
        local growth=sequence({{0,0},{.3,1},{.6,2.5},{.8,4},{1,6}})
        emitter("AmbientSwirl",CFrame.new(0,-2.75,0),"12713358087",{Rate=4,Size=growth,
            RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-600,600),Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0,1)})
        emitter("AmbientRipple",CFrame.new(0,-2.75,0),"7216849325",{Rate=3,Size=growth,
            Squash=NumberSequence.new(0,2),RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-30,30),Transparency=sequence({{0,0},{.6,.2},{1,1}})})
        emitter("AmbientOuterMist",CFrame.new(0,-2.75,0),"7216855136",{Rate=3,
            Size=sequence({{0,0},{.3,2},{.6,5},{.8,8},{1,12}}),RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-40,40),
            Transparency=sequence({{0,1},{.2,.3},{1,1}})})
    elseif effect=="Nimb" then
        for i=1,2 do
            emitter("NimbHalo"..i,CFrame.new(-.25,2.43,.259)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(15),math.rad(-62),0),"8819682608",
                {Rate=7,Lifetime=NumberRange.new(1),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(5,5),
                Size=NumberSequence.new(i==1 and 2.5 or 2,3),RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-400,400)})
        end
    else
        emitter("TornadoGroundVortex",CFrame.new(0,-3,0),"8553497052",{Rate=1,Lifetime=NumberRange.new(2),
            Speed=NumberRange.new(.01),Size=NumberSequence.new(6,10),RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(360)})
    end
    e.referenceEffect=effect
end

local function allowedVisual(item)
    return item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("Folder") or item:IsA("Attachment")
        or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or item:IsA("Beam") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Light")
        or item:IsA("SpecialMesh") or item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("Texture")
        or item:IsA("Fire") or item:IsA("Smoke") or item:IsA("Sparkles")
end
function Aura:_EnsureAsset(c)
    local name=MODEL_IDS[c.ModelEffect] and c.ModelEffect or "Angel"
    local reload=n(c.ModelReload,0,0,1000000000)
    self.assets=self.assets or {}
    local slot=self.assets[name]
    if slot and slot.reload==reload then return slot end
    if slot and slot.template then slot.template:Destroy() end
    slot={reload=reload,status="Loading",name=name};self.assets[name]=slot
    task.spawn(function()
        if self.destroyed or self.assets[name]~=slot then return end
        local ok,objects=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..MODEL_IDS[name]) end)
        local root=Instance.new("Folder");root.Name=name
        local accepted=false
        if ok and type(objects)=="table" then
            local total=0
            for _,object in ipairs(objects) do
                if typeof(object)=="Instance" then
                    object.Parent=nil
                    local descendants=object:GetDescendants();total+=#descendants+1
                    if total<=256 and allowedVisual(object) then
                        for _,item in ipairs(descendants) do if not allowedVisual(item) then item:Destroy() end end
                        for _,item in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
                            if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                                item.Anchored=true;item.CanCollide=false;item.CanTouch=false;item.CanQuery=false;item.CastShadow=false
                            elseif item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then item:Clear() end
                        end
                        object.Parent=root;accepted=true
                    else object:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end
        if self.destroyed or self.assets[name]~=slot then root:Destroy();return end
        if accepted then slot.template=root;slot.status="Ready"
        else
            root:Destroy();slot.status="Unavailable"
            warn("[Cloudy Auras] "..name.." model unavailable ("..MODEL_IDS[name].."); using particle aura.")
        end
    end)
    return slot
end

function Aura:_InstallAsset(e,state,c,slot)
    if not slot or not slot.template then return false end
    local clone=slot.template:Clone()
    e.referenceEmitters={};e.referenceAccents={};e.referenceAttachments={};e.assetParts={}
    local descendants=clone:GetDescendants()
    local sourceRoot=clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
    local origin=sourceRoot and sourceRoot:IsA("BasePart") and sourceRoot.CFrame or CFrame.new()
    local emitterCount,partCount,lightCount,beamCount=0,0,0,0
    local proxies={}
    local function proxyFor(container)
        if proxies[container] then return proxies[container] end
        local target,parent=nil,container
        while not target and parent and parent~=clone do
            target=bodyPart(state.Model,parent.Name);parent=parent.Parent
        end
        local part=physicalPart("Part","AuraLimbProxy",clone)
        e.assetParts[#e.assetParts+1]={item=part,target=target or state.RootPart,cf=CFrame.new(),size=part.Size,
            transparency=1,color=WHITE,carrier=true}
        partCount+=1;proxies[container]=part
        return part
    end
    for _,item in ipairs(descendants) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            partCount+=1
            if partCount>40 then clone:Destroy();return false end
            local target=bodyPart(state.Model,item.Name)
            local carrier=target~=nil
            local parent=item.Parent
            local reference=origin
            while not target and parent and parent~=clone do
                target=bodyPart(state.Model,parent.Name)
                if target and parent:IsA("BasePart") then reference=parent.CFrame end
                parent=parent.Parent
            end
            local cf=carrier and CFrame.new() or reference:ToObjectSpace(item.CFrame)
            e.assetParts[#e.assetParts+1]={item=item,target=target or state.RootPart,cf=cf,size=item.Size,
                transparency=carrier and 1 or item.Transparency,color=item.Color,carrier=carrier}
            if carrier then
                item.Transparency=1
                for _,child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then child.Transparency=1 end end
            end
        elseif item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            emitterCount+=1
            if emitterCount>24 then clone:Destroy();return false end
            if not item.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and not item.Parent:IsA("Attachment") then item.Parent=proxyFor(item.Parent) end
            rememberEmitter(e,item)
        elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
            if not item.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and not item.Parent:IsA("Attachment") then item.Parent=proxyFor(item.Parent) end
            e.referenceAttachments[#e.referenceAttachments+1]={item=item,cf=item.CFrame}
        elseif item:IsA("Beam") or item:IsA("Trail") then
            beamCount+=1
            if beamCount>48 then item:Destroy();continue end
            if item:IsA("Beam") then item.Segments=math.clamp(item.Segments,1,12)
            else item.Lifetime=math.min(item.Lifetime,1.5) end
            e.referenceAccents[#e.referenceAccents+1]={item=item,color=item.Color,transparency=item.Transparency,
                enabled=item.Enabled,width0=item:IsA("Beam") and item.Width0 or nil,width1=item:IsA("Beam") and item.Width1 or nil}
        elseif item:IsA("Light") then
            lightCount+=1
            if lightCount>2 then item:Destroy();continue end
            e.referenceAccents[#e.referenceAccents+1]={item=item,color=item.Color,brightness=item.Brightness,
                range=item:IsA("PointLight") and item.Range or nil,enabled=item.Enabled}
        elseif item:IsA("Fire") or item:IsA("Smoke") or item:IsA("Sparkles") then
            -- Legacy emitters have no aggregate particle budget; the particle/model presets use ParticleEmitter.
            item:Destroy()
        end
    end
    if partCount>40 then clone:Destroy();return false end
    e.assetModel=clone;e.modelLoaded=true;clone.Parent=e.folder
    return true
end

function Aura:_DrawReference(e,c,color,opacity,glow,brightness,scale,pulse,secondary)
    local authored=c.KeepModelColors and c.ColorMode=="Theme Colors"
    local animation=n(c.AnimationSpeed,1,0,3)
    local fast=math.max(1,animation)
    local speed=n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)*animation
    local rate=n(c.ParticleRate,12,0,40)/12
    local lifetime=n(c.ParticleLifetime,1.5,.3,3)/1.5
    local size=n(c.ParticleSize,.22,.05,1.2)/.22*scale
    local stamp=table.concat({animation,speed,rate,lifetime,size,opacity,tostring(glow),brightness,tostring(c.Particles),
        tostring(c.ParticleTrails),tostring(authored),tostring(c.WorldLight),c.Quality or "Balanced"},"|")
    if stamp~=e.referenceStamp or e.referenceColor~=color or e.referenceSecondary~=secondary then
        local tintSequence=ColorSequence.new(color,secondary or color)
        local total=0
        for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceEmitters) do total+=p.rate*rate*math.min(4,p.lifetime.Max*lifetime) end
        local budget=c.Quality=="Low" and 48 or c.Quality=="High" and 160 or 96
        local density=math.min(1,budget/math.max(total,1))
        for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceEmitters) do
            local item=p.item
            local enabled=c.Particles and rate>0 and opacity>0 and p.enabled
            if item.Enabled and not enabled then item:Clear() end
            item.Enabled=enabled;item.Rate=math.min(80,p.rate*rate*density*fast)
            item.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(math.clamp(p.lifetime.Min*lifetime,.05,4)/fast,math.clamp(p.lifetime.Max*lifetime,.05,4)/fast)
            item.Size=scaledSequence(p.size,size,false)
            item.Transparency=scaledSequence(p.transparency,opacity,true)
            item.Color=e.modelLoaded and authored and p.color or tintSequence
            item.Speed=NumberRange.new(p.speed.Min*n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)*fast,p.speed.Max*n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)*fast)
            item.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(p.spin.Min*n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)*fast,p.spin.Max*n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)*fast)
            item.TimeScale=math.clamp((p.time or 1)*math.min(1,animation),0,1)
            item.LockedToPart=p.followBody or not c.ParticleTrails
            item.Brightness=brightness;item.LightInfluence=0;item.LightEmission=glow and 1 or 0
        end
        for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceAccents) do
            local item=p.item
            if item:IsA("Light") then
                item.Enabled=c.WorldLight and glow and opacity>0 and p.enabled
                item.Brightness=math.min(4,p.brightness*brightness*.5*opacity)
                item.Color=authored and p.color or color
                if p.range then item.Range=math.min(32,p.range*scale) end
            else
                item.Enabled=p.enabled and opacity>0
                item.Color=authored and p.color or tintSequence
                item.Transparency=scaledSequence(p.transparency,opacity,true)
                item.LightEmission=glow and 1 or 0
                if p.width0 then item.Width0=p.width0*scale;item.Width1=p.width1*scale;item.Brightness=brightness end
            end
        end
        e.referenceStamp=stamp;e.referenceColor=color;e.referenceSecondary=secondary
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceEmitters) do p.item.LocalTransparencyModifier=1-pulse end
    if e.referenceScale~=scale then
        for _,a in ipairs(e.referenceAttachments) do a.item.CFrame=scaledFrame(a.cf,scale) end
        e.referenceScale=scale
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.assetParts) do
        if p.target.Parent then p.item.CFrame=p.target.CFrame*scaledFrame(p.cf,scale) end
        if p.appliedScale~=scale then p.item.Size=p.size*scale;p.appliedScale=scale end
        p.item.Transparency=1-(1-p.transparency)*opacity*pulse
        p.item.Color=authored and p.color or color
    end
end

-- Comet follows the three orbit streams in the supplied source. Native beams
-- preserve depth occlusion without requiring its unavailable bloom PNG.
function Aura:_BuildComet(e,c)
    local cap=c.Quality=="Low" and 8 or c.Quality=="High" and 24 or 16
    local count=math.min(cap,math.floor(n(c.CometTrailLength,16,6,24)))
    e.comets={}
    for stream=1,3 do
        local group=self:_Group(e,"comet"..stream);group.comet=true
        local points={}
        for i=1,count+1 do points[i]=Vector3.zero end
        local path=self:_Path(e,group,points,false,n(c.CometWidth,.045,.015,.15),"primary","comet")
        local head=self:_Shape(e,group,"Part","CometHead",Vector3.new(.14,.14,.14),CFrame.new(),"primary",1)
        head.cometHead=true
        e.comets[stream]={path=path,head=head,stream=stream}
    end
end
function Aura:_MoveComets(e,c)
    if not e.comets then return end
    local radius=n(c.CometRadius,.55,.1,4)
    local spacing=n(c.CometSpacing,1.5,.2,5)
    local angle=self.phase*n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)*10/3
    local headSize=n(c.CometHeadSize,.14,.05,.5)*n(c.ParticleSize,.22,.05,1.2)/.22
    for _,comet in ipairs(e.comets) do
        local path=comet.path
        local count=#path.points-1
        for i=1,count+1 do
            local theta=angle-(i-1)*1.5/count*spacing
            local x,y=math.sin(theta)*radius,math.cos(theta)*radius
            path.points[i]=comet.stream==1 and Vector3.new(x,y,-y)
                or comet.stream==2 and Vector3.new(-x,x,-y) or Vector3.new(-x,-x,y)
        end
        path.width=n(c.CometWidth,.045,.015,.15)
        path.lastScale=nil
        comet.head.cf=CFrame.new(path.points[1])
        comet.head.size=Vector3.new(headSize,headSize,headSize)
    end
end

function Aura:_Create(key,state,c,theme)
    if not self.folder then self.folder=Instance.new("Folder");self.folder.Name="CloudyThemedAuras";self.folder.Parent=workspace end
    local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name=theme;folder.Parent=self.folder
    local e={folder=folder,model=state.Model,root=state.RootPart,groups={},parts={},paths={},theme=theme,
        signature=signature(c,theme),source=sourceOf(c),nextGround=0}
    e.anchor=physicalPart("Part","AuraOrigin",folder)
    e.highlight=Instance.new("Highlight");e.highlight.Adornee=state.Model;e.highlight.Parent=folder
    e.light=Instance.new("PointLight");e.light.Shadows=false;e.light.Enabled=false;e.light.Parent=e.anchor
    local emission=Instance.new("Attachment");emission.Position=Vector3.new(0,.4,.8);emission.Parent=e.anchor
    e.emitters={}
    for i=1,2 do
        local emitter=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emitter.Name=i==1 and "AuraMotes" or "AuraHaze"
        emitter.Texture=i==1 and "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds" or "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
        emitter.LightInfluence=0;emitter.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top
        emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(30,30);emitter.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360)
        emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-35,35);emitter.Drag=.8;emitter.Enabled=false
        emitter.Parent=emission;e.emitters[i]=emitter
    end
    self.entries[key]=e
    if e.source~="Wings & Halo" then
        local installed=e.source=="Model Aura" and self:_InstallAsset(e,state,c,self.assets and self.assets[c.ModelEffect or "Angel"])
        if not installed then self:_ReferenceParticles(e,c) end
    end
    self:_Layout(e,c)
    return e
end

function Aura:_Ground(e,state,c,scale)
    local root=state.RootPart
    local pos=root.Position
    local hum=state.Humanoid
    local extra=hum and hum.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or 0
    local y=pos.Y-(hum and hum.HipHeight or 0)-root.Size.Y*.5-extra
    if c.GroundFollow and self.clock>=e.nextGround then
        e.nextGround=self.clock+.15
        local params=e.groundParams
        if not params then
            params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances={state.Model,self.folder};e.groundParams=params
        end
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(pos+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-24,0),params)
        e.groundY=hit and hit.Position.Y or nil
    end
    if c.GroundFollow then y=e.groundY or y end
    return CFrame.new(pos.X,y+n(c.HeightOffset,.08,-3,8)*scale,pos.Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(n(c.SpinSpeed,35,-360,360))*self.phase,0)
end

function Aura:_Particles(e,c,color,secondary,opacity,glow,brightness,scale)
    local rate=n(c.ParticleRate,12,0,40)
    local lifetime=n(c.ParticleLifetime,1.5,.3,3)
    local size=n(c.ParticleSize,.22,.05,1.2)*scale
    local speed=n(c.ParticleSpeed,1,0,5)
    local haze=e.theme=="Demon" or e.theme=="Fallen Angel"
    local stamp=table.concat({rate,lifetime,size,speed,opacity,tostring(glow),brightness,tostring(c.Particles),tostring(c.ParticleTrails)},"|")
    if e.particleStamp~=stamp or e.particleColor~=color or e.particleSecondary~=secondary then
        for i,p in ipairs(e.emitters) do
            local enabled=c.Particles and rate>0 and opacity>0 and (i==1 or haze)
            if not enabled and p.Enabled then p:Clear() end
            p.Enabled=enabled
            p.Rate=rate*(haze and (i==1 and .7 or .3) or (i==1 and 1 or 0))
            p.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(lifetime*.65,lifetime)
            p.Speed=NumberRange.new(speed*.35,speed*(i==1 and 1 or .6))
            p.LockedToPart=not c.ParticleTrails
            p.Color=ColorSequence.new(color,secondary)
            p.Brightness=brightness;p.LightEmission=glow and 1 or 0
            p.Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,e.theme=="Demon" and 1.2 or .25,0)
            p.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,size*.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.2,size*(i==1 and 1 or 2.3)),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
            p.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.15,1-opacity*(i==1 and .75 or .28)),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        end
        e.particleStamp=stamp;e.particleColor=color;e.particleSecondary=secondary
    end
end

-- Appearance changes are infrequent; pose updates stay on the existing render callback.
function Aura:_CloseCamera(state,c,camera,wasHidden)
    if c.HideInFirstPerson==false then return false end
    local radius=n(c.CameraHideDistance,3,1,6)+(wasHidden and .6 or 0)
    local point=state.HitboxHead and state.HitboxHead.Parent and state.HitboxHead.Position or state.RootPart.Position
    return (camera.CFrame.Position-point).Magnitude<radius
        or (camera.CFrame.Position-state.RootPart.Position).Magnitude<radius
end
function Aura:_Hide(e)
    if e.hidden then return end
    e.hidden=true;e.needsDraw=true;e.folder.Parent=nil
    for _,p in ipairs(e.emitters) do if p.Enabled then p.Enabled=false;p:Clear() end end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceEmitters or {}) do
        if p.item.Enabled then p.item.Enabled=false;p.item:Clear() end
    end
    e.highlight.Enabled=false;e.light.Enabled=false
    for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceAccents or {}) do if p.item:IsA("Light") then p.item.Enabled=false end end
    e.particleStamp=nil;e.referenceStamp=nil
end
function Aura:_Draw(e,state,c,color,secondary)
    local layout=table.concat({n(c.WingSpan,8,3,14),n(c.WingLength,1,.4,2),n(c.BackOffset,.7,0,3),n(c.CrownHeight,3,1.5,5),n(c.CrownScale,1,.5,2),n(c.TailLength,3,1,6),n(c.Radius,2.8,.5,12),n(c.RingWidth,.07,.02,.5)},"|")
    if layout~=e.layout then self:_Layout(e,c) end
    local scale=n(c.Scale,1,.5,2.5)
    local opacity=n(c.Opacity,.9,0,1)
    local strength=n(c.GlowStrength,1,0,2)
    local brightness=n(c.Brightness,2,0,8)
    local glow=c.GlowEnabled and strength>0 and brightness>0
    e.scale=scale;e.opacity=opacity;e.glow=glow
    e.fill=n(c.FillOpacity,.07,0,1);e.outline=n(c.OutlineOpacity,.45,0,1)
    e.lightBrightness=n(c.LightBrightness,1,0,4)
    e.highlight.Enabled=c.BodyGlow and opacity>0
    e.highlight.DepthMode=c.ThroughWalls and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    e.highlight.FillColor=color;e.highlight.OutlineColor=secondary
    e.light.Enabled=c.WorldLight and brightness>0 and opacity>0
    e.light.Color=color;e.light.Range=n(c.LightRange,14,0,32)*scale
    e.pulseIndex=nil
    for _,p in ipairs(e.parts) do
        local wing=p.role=="feather" or p.role=="fallenFeather" or p.role=="membrane" or p.orbitIndex~=nil
        p.opacityFactor=p.opacity*(wing and n(c.WingOpacity,.9,0,1) or 1)*(p.cometHead and not c.Particles and 0 or 1)
        p.part.Size=p.size*scale;p.appliedScale=scale;p.appliedSize=p.size
        p.part.Material=(glow and p.role~="membrane") and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        local tint=color
        if p.role=="feather" then tint=c.ColorMode=="Theme Colors" and secondary or color:Lerp(secondary,.2)
        elseif p.role=="fallenFeather" then tint=color:Lerp(BLACK,.55)
        elseif p.role=="membrane" then tint=color:Lerp(BLACK,.72)
        elseif p.role=="secondary" then tint=secondary end
        p.part.Color=tint
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.paths) do
        if p.kind=="comet" then p.width=n(c.CometWidth,.045,.015,.15) end
        p.alphaCache={};p.opacityFactor=1;p.glowStrength=strength
        if p.kind=="seal" then p.opacityFactor=n(c.RingOpacity,.7,0,1)
        elseif p.kind=="wing" or p.kind=="orbital" then p.opacityFactor=n(c.WingOpacity,.9,0,1)
        elseif p.kind=="comet" and not c.Particles then p.opacityFactor=0 end
        local a,b=p.role=="secondary" and secondary or color,p.role=="secondary" and color or secondary
        local sequence=ColorSequence.new(a,b)
        for lineIndex,pair in ipairs(p.lines) do
            local core,soft=pair[1],pair[2]
            core.Color=sequence;soft.Color=sequence
            local taper=p.kind=="comet" and (1-(lineIndex-1)/#p.lines)^1.1 or 1
            local width=p.width*scale*taper
            core.Width0=width;core.Width1=width
            core.Enabled=opacity*p.opacityFactor>0;core.LightEmission=glow and math.min(1,strength) or 0;core.Brightness=brightness
            soft.Width0=width*(2+n(c.GlowWidth,.65,.1,2)*4);soft.Width1=soft.Width0
            soft.Enabled=glow and opacity*p.opacityFactor>0;soft.LightEmission=1;soft.Brightness=brightness
        end
    end
    if e.source=="Wings & Halo" then self:_Particles(e,c,color,secondary,opacity,glow,brightness,scale)
    else self:_DrawReference(e,c,color,opacity,glow,brightness*(glow and strength or 1),scale,1,secondary) end
    e.color=color;e.secondary=secondary;e.needsDraw=false
end
function Aura:_Tint(e,c,color,secondary)
    local authored=c.KeepModelColors and c.ColorMode=="Theme Colors"
    local tintSequence=ColorSequence.new(color,secondary)
    e.highlight.FillColor=color;e.highlight.OutlineColor=secondary;e.light.Color=color
    for _,p in ipairs(e.parts) do
        local tint=color
        if p.role=="feather" then tint=c.ColorMode=="Theme Colors" and secondary or color:Lerp(secondary,.2)
        elseif p.role=="fallenFeather" then tint=color:Lerp(BLACK,.55)
        elseif p.role=="membrane" then tint=color:Lerp(BLACK,.72)
        elseif p.role=="secondary" then tint=secondary end
        p.part.Color=tint
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.paths) do
        local a,b=p.role=="secondary" and secondary or color,p.role=="secondary" and color or secondary
        local sequence=ColorSequence.new(a,b)
        for _,pair in ipairs(p.lines) do pair[1].Color=sequence;pair[2].Color=sequence end
    end
    local simpleSequence=ColorSequence.new(color,secondary)
    for _,p in ipairs(e.emitters) do p.Color=simpleSequence end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceEmitters or {}) do p.item.Color=e.modelLoaded and authored and p.color or tintSequence end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceAccents or {}) do
        p.item.Color=authored and p.color or (p.item:IsA("Light") and color or tintSequence)
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.assetParts or {}) do p.item.Color=authored and p.color or color end
    e.color=color;e.secondary=secondary;e.referenceColor=color;e.referenceSecondary=secondary;e.particleColor=color;e.particleSecondary=secondary
end
function Aura:_Follow(e,state,c)
    local root=state.RootPart
    local scale=e.scale
    local forward=Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X,0,root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
    if not Style.Vector(forward) or forward.Magnitude<.001 then forward=Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
    local base=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position+forward)
    e.moveParts=e.moveParts or {};e.moveFrames=e.moveFrames or {}
    local parts,frames=e.moveParts,e.moveFrames
    local count=0
    local function move(part,cf)
        if part.CFrame~=cf then count+=1;parts[count]=part;frames[count]=cf end
    end
    move(e.anchor,base)
    self:_MoveComets(e,c)
    local flap=c.WingFlap and math.sin(self.phase*n(c.WingSpeed,.55,.1,3)*TAU)*math.rad(n(c.WingFlapAmount,10,0,35)) or 0
    for key,g in pairs(e.groups) do
        local cf=base*CFrame.new(g.offset*scale)
        if g.comet then cf=CFrame.new(root.Position)
        elseif g.side then cf*=CFrame.Angles(0,g.side*flap,g.side*flap*.15)
        elseif key=="crown" and e.theme~="Demon" then cf*=CFrame.Angles(.12+math.sin(self.phase)*.07,self.phase*.35,0)
        elseif g.index then cf*=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(g.index==1 and 55 or -55)+flap,self.phase*(g.index==1 and .6 or -.45),math.rad(20))
        elseif key=="seal" then cf=self:_Ground(e,state,c,scale) end
        g.frame=cf;move(g.anchor,cf)
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.parts) do
        local cf=p.cf
        if p.orbitIndex then
            local a=self.phase*.65+p.orbitIndex*TAU/6
            local radius=n(c.WingSpan,8,3,14)*.28
            cf=CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*radius,math.sin(a*1.7)*1.2,math.sin(a)*radius)
        end
        if p.tailTip then cf+=Vector3.new(math.sin(self.phase*1.2+2)*.32,math.cos(self.phase+1)*.1,0) end
        move(p.part,p.group.frame*scaledFrame(cf,scale))
        if p.appliedSize~=p.size then p.part.Size=p.size*scale;p.appliedSize=p.size end
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.paths) do
        if p.lastScale~=scale or p.kind=="tail" or p.kind=="comet" then
            for i,a in ipairs(p.attachments) do
                local point=p.points[i]
                if p.kind=="tail" then
                    local t=(i-1)/math.max(1,#p.points-1)
                    point+=Vector3.new(math.sin(self.phase*1.2+t*2)*.32*t,math.cos(self.phase+t)*.1*t,0)
                end
                a.Position=point*scale
            end
            p.lastScale=scale
        end
    end
    for _,p in ipairs(e.assetParts or {}) do
        if p.target.Parent then move(p.item,p.target.CFrame*scaledFrame(p.cf,scale)) end
    end
    for i=#parts,count+1,-1 do parts[i]=nil;frames[i]=nil end
    if count>3 and workspace.BulkMoveTo then
        workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts,frames,Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
    else for i=1,count do parts[i].CFrame=frames[i] end end
    local pulse=c.Pulse and (1-n(c.PulseStrength,.15,0,.8)*(.5+.5*math.sin(self.phase*n(c.PulseSpeed,1.2,.1,5)*TAU))) or 1
    local index=math.floor(pulse*48+.5)
    if index~=e.pulseIndex then
        pulse=index/48
        local opacity=e.opacity*pulse
        e.highlight.FillTransparency=1-e.fill*opacity;e.highlight.OutlineTransparency=1-e.outline*opacity
        e.light.Brightness=e.lightBrightness*opacity
        for _,p in ipairs(e.parts) do p.part.Transparency=1-opacity*p.opacityFactor end
        for _,p in ipairs(e.paths) do
            local alpha=p.alphaCache[index]
            if not alpha then
                local pathOpacity=opacity*p.opacityFactor
                alpha={NumberSequence.new(1-pathOpacity),NumberSequence.new(1-math.clamp(pathOpacity*.22*p.glowStrength,0,.65))}
                p.alphaCache[index]=alpha
            end
            for _,pair in ipairs(p.lines) do pair[1].Transparency=alpha[1];pair[2].Transparency=alpha[2] end
        end
        for _,p in ipairs(e.referenceEmitters or {}) do p.item.LocalTransparencyModifier=1-pulse end
        for _,p in ipairs(e.assetParts or {}) do p.item.Transparency=1-(1-p.transparency)*opacity end
        e.pulseIndex=index
    end
end

function Aura:_Observe(c)
    local old=self.settings
    local dirty=not old
    local tintOnly=old~=nil
    if not old then old={};self.settings=old end
    for key,value in pairs(c) do
        if old[key]~=value then
            dirty=true;old[key]=value
            if key~="Color" and key~="SecondaryColor" then tintOnly=false end
        end
    end
    for key in pairs(old) do if c[key]==nil then old[key]=nil;dirty=true;tintOnly=false end end
    return dirty,tintOnly
end
function Aura:_Select(c,camera)
    self.selected=self.selected or {};self.candidateSlots=self.candidateSlots or {};self.keep=self.keep or {}
    local list,slots,keep=self.selected,self.candidateSlots,self.keep
    table.clear(list);table.clear(keep)
    local own=self.fighters.LocalState
    local count=0
    local function consider(fighter,isLocal)
        if not fighter or not fighter.Character then return end
        local state=fighter.Character.State
        if not state or not state.Alive or not state.RootPart or not state.RootPart.Parent or not state.Model.Parent or not Style.Vector(state.RootPart.Position) then return end
        if not isLocal and own and fighter.EnvironmentId~=own.EnvironmentId then return end
        local target=c.Targets
        local show=(target=="Local Player" and isLocal) or (target=="Enemies" and not isLocal and fighter.IsEnemy)
            or (target=="Teammates" and not isLocal and not fighter.IsEnemy) or target=="Everyone"
        if not show then return end
        local distance=(state.RootPart.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
        if distance>n(c.MaxDistance,300,10,2000) then return end
        count+=1
        local slot=slots[count]
        if not slot then slot={};slots[count]=slot end
        slot.key=fighter;slot.distance=distance;list[count]=slot
    end
    consider(own,true)
    if c.Targets~="Local Player" then
        for _,fighter in pairs(self.fighters.StateByPlayer) do if fighter~=own then consider(fighter,false) end end
    end
    table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a.distance<b.distance end)
    local cap=math.floor(n(c.MaxTargets,4,1,8))
    for i=#list,cap+1,-1 do list[i]=nil end
    for _,candidate in ipairs(list) do keep[candidate.key]=true end
    for key in pairs(self.entries) do if not keep[key] then self:_Remove(key) end end
    for i=#slots,count+1,-1 do slots[i]=nil end
    self.nextSelection=self.clock+.1
end
function Aura:Update(dt)
    if self.destroyed then return end
    dt=n(dt,1/60,0,.2);self.clock+=dt
    local c=Store.Data.VisualAuras
    if not c or not c.Enabled then
        if self.folder then self:_Clear() end
        if self.selected then table.clear(self.selected) end
        self.nextSelection=0;return
    end
    self.phase+=dt*n(c.AnimationSpeed,1,0,3)
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then self:_Clear();self.nextSelection=0;return end
    local dirty,tintOnly=false,true
    if self.clock>=self.nextFrame then
        self.nextFrame=self.clock+1/n(c.UpdateRate,30,10,60)
        dirty,tintOnly=self:_Observe(c)
        self.theme=themeOf(c);self.color,self.secondary=colors(c,self.theme)
        self.mark=signature(c,self.theme)
        if dirty then self.slot=nil end
    end
    if (dirty and not tintOnly) or self.clock>=(self.nextSelection or 0) or not self.selected then self:_Select(c,camera) end
    local own=self.fighters.LocalState
    for _,candidate in ipairs(self.selected) do
        local key=candidate.key
        local state=key.Character and key.Character.State
        local e=self.entries[key]
        if not state or not state.Alive or not state.RootPart or not state.RootPart.Parent or not state.Model.Parent
            or not Style.Vector(state.RootPart.Position) or (key~=own and own and key.EnvironmentId~=own.EnvironmentId) then
            if e then self:_Remove(key) end
            self.nextSelection=0;continue
        end
        if (state.RootPart.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude>n(c.MaxDistance,300,10,2000) then
            if e then self:_Hide(e) end
            continue
        end
        if key==own and self:_CloseCamera(state,c,camera,e and e.hidden) then
            if e then self:_Hide(e) end
            continue
        end
        if sourceOf(c)=="Model Aura" and not self.slot then self.slot=self:_EnsureAsset(c) end
        local mark=self.mark..(sourceOf(c)=="Model Aura" and self.slot and self.slot.status or "")
        if e and (e.model~=state.Model or e.signature~=mark) then self:_Remove(key);e=nil end
        if not e then e=self:_Create(key,state,c,self.theme);e.needsDraw=true;e.signature=mark end
        if e.hidden then e.hidden=false;e.folder.Parent=self.folder;e.needsDraw=true end
        if e.needsDraw or (dirty and not tintOnly) then self:_Draw(e,state,c,self.color,self.secondary)
        elseif e.color~=self.color or e.secondary~=self.secondary then self:_Tint(e,c,self.color,self.secondary) end
        self:_Follow(e,state,c)
    end
    if next(self.entries)==nil and self.folder then self.folder:Destroy();self.folder=nil end
end

function Aura:Destroy()
    if self.destroyed then return end
    self.destroyed=true;self:_Clear()
    for _,slot in pairs(self.assets or {}) do if slot.template then slot.template:Destroy() end end
    self.assets={}
end
Aura.BuiltinNames={"Angelic","Ambient","Nimb","Tornado","Comet","Angel","Starlight","Heavenly","Ribbon","Sakura","Wind","Flow","Star"}
Aura.ModelIds=MODEL_IDS
Aura.Themes={"Angel","Demon","Fallen Angel","Celestial"}
return Aura

end

    if self.player then environment=self.player:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
    elseif fighter then environment=fighter.EnvironmentId end
    local duel=self.duelers and self.duelers.LocalState
    local crosshair=self.crosshair
    local weaponActive=crosshair and crosshair._gui and crosshair._gui.Enabled==true
    local hook=crosshair and crosshair._gameHook
    if hook and type(hook.IsCrosshairActive)=="function" then
        local ok,active=pcall(hook.IsCrosshairActive,hook)
        weaponActive=weaponActive or (ok and active==true)
    end
    if environment~=nil or duel~=nil or weaponActive then
        self.lastMatchEvidence=self.elapsed;return true
    end
    -- A short context/attribute gap is not a confirmed return to the lobby.
    return self.lastMatchEvidence~=nil and self.elapsed-self.lastMatchEvidence<=EXIT_GRACE
end
function Status:_ValidateFont()
    if not self.fontCheckAt or self.elapsed<self.fontCheckAt then return end
    self.fontCheckAt=nil
    local bounds=self.label.TextBounds
    if self.label.Text~="" and (not bounds or bounds.X<=0 or bounds.Y<=0) then
        self.label.Font=Enum.Font.Arcade
    end
end
function Status:Debug()
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    local viewport=camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(0,0)
    local environment=self.player and self.player:GetAttribute("EnvironmentID")
    local crosshair=self.crosshair
    return string.format("wanted=%s active=%s environment=%s duel=%s crosshair=%s gui=%s parent=%s label=%s xy=%.0f,%.0f viewport=%.0f,%.0f",
        tostring(self:_Wanted()),tostring(self:_Enabled()),tostring(environment~=nil),
        tostring(self.duelers~=nil and self.duelers.LocalState~=nil),
        tostring(crosshair~=nil and crosshair._gui~=nil and crosshair._gui.Enabled==true),
        tostring(self.gui~=nil and self.gui.Enabled),tostring(self.gui~=nil and self.gui.Parent~=nil),
        tostring(self.label~=nil and self.label.Visible),self.x or 0,self.y or 0,viewport.X,viewport.Y)
end
function Status:Update(dt)
    if self.destroyed then return end
    self.elapsed+=finite(dt) and math.clamp(dt,0,.5) or 1/60
    local enabled=self:_CanShow()
    if not enabled then
        if self.gui and self.gui.Enabled then self.gui.Enabled=false end
        self.wasEnabled=false;self.previousState=nil;self.eliminatedUntil=nil
        return
    end
    if not self.wasEnabled then self.nextPoll=0;self.wasEnabled=true end
    if self.gui and self.gui.Parent==nil then
        self.gui:Destroy();self.gui=nil;self.label=nil;self.stroke=nil
    end
    if not self.gui then self:_Create() end
    self:_Layout()
    if not self.label.Visible then self.label.Visible=true end
    if not self.gui.Enabled then self.gui.Enabled=true end
    if self.elapsed<self.nextPoll then return end
    self.nextPoll=self.elapsed+.1
    local text="ragebot: "..string.lower(self:_Read(os.clock())).."..."
    if self.text~=text then self.label.Text=text;self.text=text end
    self:_ValidateFont()
    if not self.gui.Enabled then self.gui.Enabled=true end
end
function Status:Destroy()
    if self.destroyed then return end
    self.destroyed=true
    if K.RagebotStatus==self then K.RagebotStatus=nil end
    if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
    self.gui=nil;self.label=nil;self.stroke=nil
    self.ragebot=nil;self.crosshair=nil;self.player=nil;self.duelers=nil;self.fallbackFighter=nil;self.previousState=nil;self.lastMatchEvidence=nil
end
return Status

end

local GlobalTrove = tbl17.n()

-- Decode embedded menu artwork once before the original menu is built.
do
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local map = {}
    for i = 1, 64 do map[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    local function decode(s)
        local out = buffer.create(#s * 3 // 4 + 3)
        local n = 0
        for i = 1, #s, 4 do
            local a, b, c, d = s:byte(i, i + 3)
            local vc, vd = map[c], map[d]
            local v = map[a] * 262144 + map[b] * 4096 + (vc or 0) * 64 + (vd or 0)
            buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.rshift(v, 16))
            n += 1
            if vc then buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v, 8), 255)); n += 1 end
            if vd then buffer.writeu8(out, n, bit32.band(v, 255)); n += 1 end
        end
        return buffer.readstring(out, 0, n)
    end
    local writeAsset, loadAsset = K.fn("writefile"), K.fn("getcustomasset") or K.fn("getsynasset")
    if writeAsset and loadAsset then
        local folderExists, makeFolder = K.fn("isfolder"), K.fn("makefolder")
        if makeFolder then
            pcall(function() if not folderExists or not folderExists("LeeLin") then makeFolder("LeeLin") end end)
        end
        for _, artwork in ipairs(CLOUDY_MENU_ART) do
            local ok, image = pcall(function()
                writeAsset(artwork.Path, decode(artwork.Data))
                return loadAsset(artwork.Path)
            end)
            if ok then K[artwork.Key] = image
            else warn("[Cloudy UI] Unable to load " .. artwork.Key .. ": " .. tostring(image)) end
        end
    else
        warn("[Cloudy UI] Custom artwork requires writefile and getcustomasset.")
    end
end


tbl17.b().use({ Report = function(_, e)
    local detail = type(e) == "table" and (e.Detail or e.Operation) or e
    warn("[LeeLin.gg] " .. tostring(detail))
end })

local bootFn = function()
    local store = tbl17.bG()
    local profiles = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bN().new(store))
    store:UseMiddleware(profiles)
    local fonts = tbl17.az()
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.aB().use(store, { "Notifications" }, { "Theme" }, function(f) return fonts:Get(f) end,
        tbl17.bI().Notifications))

    local reporter = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.ad().new())
    local state = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.ae().new("LeeLin/rivals"))
    local stateData = state:Load()
    if stateData.AutoLoad and stateData.AutoLoadConfigName ~= nil then
        local r = reporter:ReportResult(store:LoadFromFile(stateData.AutoLoadConfigName))
        if not r.Ok then
            local text = "Failed to auto-load the selected config"
            if string.find(r.Error.Detail, "newer than current version", 1, true) ~= nil then
                text = "Your selected config was saved by a newer version - update or pick another config"
            end
            tbl17.aB().get():Notify(text)
        elseif #tbl17.bc().takeDroppedPaths() > 0 then
            tbl17.aB().get():Notify("Some saved settings could not be restored and were reset to defaults")
        end
    end

    K.AutoRun = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.kS().new(store))

    local Theme = tbl17.A()
    local theme = store.Data.Theme
    if theme ~= nil then
        for k, v in next, theme do
            if Theme.Tokens[k] ~= nil and typeof(v) == "Color3" then Theme.refresh(k, v) end
        end
    end

    local registry = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bK().new())
    local identities = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bL().new(registry))
    local tags = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bM().new(registry))
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bR().new(tags, registry))
    GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.bZ().new(identities))
    local avatar = GlobalTrove:Add(tbl17.b6().new(registry))

    return {
        StoreProfiles = profiles,
        PlayerRegistry = registry,
        PlayerIdentities = identities,
        PlayerTags = tags,
        DecoratorFactory = avatar ~= nil and avatar:GetDecoratorFactory() or nil,
        ArmAvatarSpoofer = function() avatar:Arm() end,
        GeneralState = state,
        GeneralStateData = stateData,
    }
end

function K.Unload()
    if K.destroyed then return end
    K.destroyed = true
    for _, f in ipairs(K.cleanups) do pcall(f) end
    pcall(function() GlobalTrove:Destroy() end)
    if getgenv().LeeLinRebuild == K then getgenv().LeeLinRebuild = nil end
end

    for k, v in pairs(V3_DEFAULTS) do
        if rageDefaults and rageDefaults[k] == nil then rageDefaults[k] = v end
        if rageData and rageData[k] == nil then rageData[k] = v end
    end

    local KATANA_BYPASS_WEAPONS = {
        ["RPG"] = true,
        ["Grenade Launcher"] = true,
        ["Flare Gun"] = true,
        ["Exogun"] = true,
        ["Bow"] = true,
        ["Crossbow"] = true,
        ["Spray"] = true,
        ["Flamethrower"] = true,
    }

    local MELEE_WEAPONS = {
        ["Knife"] = true,
        ["Katana"] = true,
        ["Scythe"] = true,
        ["Chainsaw"] = true,
        ["Fists"] = true,
        ["Trowel"] = true,
        ["Battle Axe"] = true,
        ["Riot Shield"] = true,
    }

    local ResolverCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local groundRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    groundRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    groundRayParams.IgnoreWater = true

    local function isFiniteVec(v)
        return typeof(v) == "Vector3"
            and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
            and math.abs(v.X) < 1e9 and math.abs(v.Y) < 1e9 and math.abs(v.Z) < 1e9
    end

    local function updateTargetResolver(fighterState, aliveState)
        if not (fighterState and aliveState and aliveState.Alive and aliveState.RootPart) then
            return nil
        end
        local now = os.clock()
        local entry = ResolverCache[fighterState]
        if not entry then
            entry = {
                history = {},
                emaVel = Vector3.zero,
                lastPos = nil,
                lastTick = now,
                lastGroundY = nil,
                jitterScore = 0,
            }
            ResolverCache[fighterState] = entry
        end

        local root = aliveState.RootPart
        local head = aliveState.HitboxHead
            or (aliveState.TargetPartsByName and aliveState.TargetPartsByName.HitboxHeadSmall)
            or root
        local rawPos = root.Position
        local rawHead = head.Position
        if not (isFiniteVec(rawPos) and isFiniteVec(rawHead)) then
            return entry
        end

        local dt = now - entry.lastTick
        if entry.lastPos and dt > 0.001 then
            local delta = rawPos - entry.lastPos
            local planar = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
            if planar > 0.01 and planar < 500 then
                local instVel = delta / math.max(dt, 0.016)
                if entry.emaVel.Magnitude > 1 then
                    local dot = instVel.Unit:Dot(entry.emaVel.Unit)
                    if dot < -0.3 and planar > 2.0 then
                        entry.jitterScore = math.min(entry.jitterScore + 1, 14)
                    else
                        entry.jitterScore = math.max(entry.jitterScore - 0.5, 0)
                    end
                end
                local alpha = (entry.jitterScore >= 3) and 0.12 or 0.4
                entry.emaVel = entry.emaVel:Lerp(instVel, alpha)
            end
        end
        entry.lastPos = rawPos
        entry.lastTick = now

        local resolvedRoot = rawPos
        local resolvedHead = rawHead
        local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot

        if cfg.ResolveSubterranean then
            groundRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { aliveState.Model, workspace.CurrentCamera }
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(rawPos + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), Vector3.new(0, -150, 0), groundRayParams)
            if hit then
                entry.lastGroundY = hit.Position.Y + 3.0
            end
            local floorY = entry.lastGroundY
            if floorY and (rawPos.Y < floorY - 4.2 or rawPos.Y < -50) then
                local hOff = rawHead.Y - rawPos.Y
                resolvedRoot = Vector3.new(rawPos.X, floorY, rawPos.Z)
                resolvedHead = Vector3.new(rawHead.X, floorY + hOff, rawHead.Z)
            end
        end

        if cfg.ResolvePanicJitter and entry.jitterScore >= 3 and #entry.history >= 4 then
            local sumR, sumH, cnt = resolvedRoot, resolvedHead, 1
            for i = #entry.history, math.max(1, #entry.history - 6), -1 do
                sumR += entry.history[i].rootPos
                sumH += entry.history[i].headPos
                cnt += 1
            end
            resolvedRoot = sumR / cnt
            resolvedHead = sumH / cnt
        end

        table.insert(entry.history, {
            t = now,
            rootPos = resolvedRoot,
            headPos = resolvedHead,
            vel = entry.emaVel,
        })

        local windowSec = math.clamp((cfg.BacktrackWindow or 220) / 1000, 0.05, 0.4)
        local cutoff = now - windowSec
        while #entry.history > 1 and entry.history[1].t < cutoff do
            table.remove(entry.history, 1)
        end

        entry.resolvedRoot = resolvedRoot
        entry.resolvedHead = resolvedHead
        return entry
    end

    tbl17.cache.kW = nil
    tbl17.kW = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.kW
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local Origins = tbl17.cG()
        local Blocking = tbl17.da()
        local Shot = {}
        local nativeSizes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        local OCTANT_DIRS = {
            Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
            Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
            Vector3.new(0.707, 0, 0.707), Vector3.new(-0.707, 0, 0.707),
            Vector3.new(0.707, 0, -0.707), Vector3.new(-0.707, 0, -0.707),
            Vector3.new(0.707, 0.707, 0), Vector3.new(-0.707, 0.707, 0),
            Vector3.new(0, 0.707, 0.707), Vector3.new(0, 0.707, -0.707),
            Vector3.new(0.577, 0.577, 0.577), Vector3.new(-0.577, 0.577, -0.577),
            Vector3.new(0.577, 0.577, -0.577), Vector3.new(-0.577, 0.577, 0.577),
            Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
        }

        function Shot.Number(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and math.abs(v) < 1e9 end
        function Shot.Vector(v)
            return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and Shot.Number(v.X) and Shot.Number(v.Y) and Shot.Number(v.Z)
        end
        function Shot.Frame(v)
            if typeof(v) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
            for _, n in { v:GetComponents() } do if not Shot.Number(n) then return false end end
            return true
        end

        function Shot.Target(target)
            local state = target and target.AliveState
            local fighter = target and target.FighterState
            if not state or not state.Alive or not state.RootPart or not state.RootPart.Parent or not Shot.Vector(state.RootPart.Position) then
                return
            end
            if fighter and fighter.Character and fighter.Character.State ~= state then return end
            if state.Humanoid and state.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

            updateTargetResolver(fighter, state)

            local head = state.HitboxHead
            if not head or not head.Parent or not Shot.Vector(head.Position) or (head.Position - state.RootPart.Position).Magnitude > 24 then
                head = state.TargetPartsByName and state.TargetPartsByName.HitboxHeadSmall
            end
            if (not head or not head.Parent) and Store.Data.Ragebot.MultiPointHitscan then
                head = state.Model:FindFirstChild("Head") or state.Model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or state.RootPart
            end
            if not head or not head.Parent or not Shot.Vector(head.Position) then return end
            return head, state
        end

        function Shot.Cooldown(item, heavy)
            local info = item.Info or item._info or {}
            local cooldown = heavy and (info.HeavyAttackCooldown or info.AttackCooldown) or (info.ShootCooldown or info.AttackCooldown)
            if not Shot.Number(cooldown) or cooldown <= 0 then cooldown = item.__type == "Gun" and 1 / 60 or 0.15 end
            if item.__type == "Gun" then
                local burst = Shot.Number(info.ShootBurst) and math.clamp(info.ShootBurst, 1, 32) or 1
                local interval = Shot.Number(info.ShootBurstCooldown) and math.max(0, info.ShootBurstCooldown) or 0
                cooldown = math.max(cooldown, interval) + (burst - 1) * interval
            end
            return math.clamp(cooldown, 1 / 120, 10)
        end

        function Shot.Origin(controller, root)
            if controller then
                local anchor = controller:GetServerOriginAnchor()
                if Shot.Frame(anchor) then return anchor.Position end
            end
            if root and root.Parent and Shot.Vector(root.Position) then
                return root.Position + Origins.getServerOriginOffset(false)
            end
        end

        function Shot.Pose(target, item, root, controller, melee, params)
            local head, state = Shot.Target(target)
            if not head then return end
            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local crouching = controller and controller:IsCrouching() or false
            local offset = Origins.getServerOriginOffset(crouching)
            local info = item.Info or item._info or {}
            local distance = melee and 2.15 or (cfg.WallbangV2 and math.clamp(cfg.ManipRadius or 16.5, 4, 28) or 6)

            local explosive = item.Name == "RPG" or item.Name == "Grenade Launcher" or item.Name == "Flare Gun" or item.Name == "Exogun"
            if explosive then
                local radius = info.ExplosionRadius or info.SplashRadius
                distance = math.max(24, Shot.Number(radius) and radius + 6 or 0)
            end
            if melee then
                local reach = info.Range or info.AttackRange
                if Shot.Number(reach) then distance = math.clamp(reach * 0.42, 0.75, 2.5) end
            end

            local fighter = target.FighterState
            local rEntry = fighter and ResolverCache[fighter]
            local headPos = melee and head.Position or ((rEntry and rEntry.resolvedHead) or head.Position)

            local look = state.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector
            local bounds
            if item.__type == "Gun" and fighter then
                local ok, constraint = pcall(Blocking.resolveShotConstraint, item, fighter, "Planning")
                if ok and constraint and Shot.Vector(constraint.Look) then
                    look = constraint.Look
                    bounds = constraint.Bounds
                end
            end
            if not Shot.Vector(look) or look.Magnitude < 0.001 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            flat = flat.Magnitude < 0.001 and Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) or flat.Unit
            local side = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)

            if params then
                local excluded = { state.Model }
                if root and root.Parent then table.insert(excluded, root.Parent) end
                if workspace.CurrentCamera then table.insert(excluded, workspace.CurrentCamera) end
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
            end

            local enemyMelee = fighter and fighter.ItemObserver and fighter.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
            local hasEnemyKnife = enemyMelee ~= nil and enemyMelee.Name ~= "Riot Shield"
            local extraY = (cfg.ElevatedKnifeCounter and hasEnemyKnife and not melee) and 6.5 or 0

            if not melee and cfg.RiotShieldBypass and enemyMelee and enemyMelee.Name == "Riot Shield" then
                local rearOrigin = headPos - (flat * math.max(distance * 0.55, 3.5)) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5 + extraY, 0)
                local delta = headPos - rearOrigin
                if not params or not workspace:Raycast(rearOrigin, delta, params) then
                    return CFrame.lookAt(rearOrigin - offset, headPos), head
                end
            end

            local directions = melee and { -flat, side, -side, flat } or OCTANT_DIRS
            local heights = extraY > 0 and { extraY, extraY + 3, 2, 0 } or { 0, 2.5, 5.5, -2.0, 4.0 }
            local radii = cfg.WallbangV2 and { distance * 0.4, distance * 0.7, distance } or { distance }

            for _, r in ipairs(radii) do
                for _, height in ipairs(heights) do
                    for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do
                        local origin = headPos + direction * r + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
                        local delta = headPos - origin
                        if delta.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                            local dot = delta.Unit:Dot(look.Unit)
                            local safe = not bounds or ((bounds.MinDot == nil or dot >= bounds.MinDot + 0.03) and (bounds.MaxDot == nil or dot <= bounds.MaxDot - 0.03))
                            if safe and (not params or not workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params)) then
                                return CFrame.lookAt(origin - offset, headPos), head
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if rEntry and #rEntry.history > 1 then
                for i = #rEntry.history - 1, 1, -1 do
                    local btHead = rEntry.history[i].headPos
                    local origin = btHead - flat * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 2 + extraY, 0)
                    local delta = btHead - origin
                    if not params or not workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params) then
                        return CFrame.lookAt(origin - offset, btHead), head
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        function Shot.RememberSize(part, size) nativeSizes[part] = size end

        function Shot.Hit(part, origin)
            local size = nativeSizes[part] or part.Size
            if not Shot.Vector(size) or size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 or size.Z <= 0 then return end
            local localOrigin = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(origin)
            local half = size * 0.5
            local ratio = math.max(math.abs(localOrigin.X) / half.X, math.abs(localOrigin.Y) / half.Y, math.abs(localOrigin.Z) / half.Z)
            if not Shot.Number(ratio) or ratio < 0.000001 then return end
            return { Part = part, ObjectSpace = localOrigin / ratio }
        end

        function Shot.Aim(controller, root, item, target)
            local head, state = Shot.Target(target)
            local origin = Shot.Origin(controller, root)
            if not head or not origin or not Shot.Vector(origin) then return end

            local fighter = target.FighterState
            local rEntry = fighter and ResolverCache[fighter]
            local point = item.__type == "Melee" and head.Position or ((rEntry and rEntry.resolvedHead) or head.Position)
            local delta = point - origin
            if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end

            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local predScale = cfg.PredictionScale or 1.0
            local velocity = (rEntry and rEntry.emaVel) or state.Velocity or state.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity

            local info = item.Info or item._info or {}
            if item.__type == "Gun" and not item.IsRaycast then
                local speed = info.ProjectileSpeed or info.BulletSpeed
                if Shot.Number(speed) and speed > 0 and Shot.Vector(velocity) and velocity.Magnitude <= 350 then
                    local flight = math.clamp(delta.Magnitude / speed, 0, 0.45) * predScale
                    point += velocity * flight
                    local gravity = info.ProjectileGravity or info.BulletGravity
                    if Shot.Number(gravity) and gravity > 0 then
                        point += Vector3.new(0, gravity * 0.5 * flight * flight, 0)
                    end
                end
            elseif item.__type == "Gun" and Shot.Vector(velocity) and velocity.Magnitude > 2 and velocity.Magnitude <= 300 and predScale > 0 then
                point += velocity * (0.032 * predScale)
            end

            local frame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, point)
            if not Shot.Frame(frame) then return end
            return frame, (item.__type ~= "Gun" or item.IsRaycast) and Shot.Hit(head, origin) or nil
        end

        Shot.ResolverCache = ResolverCache
        Shot.UpdateResolver = updateTargetResolver
        Shot.KatanaBypassWeapons = KATANA_BYPASS_WEAPONS

        cached = { c = Shot }
        tbl17.cache.kW = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    tbl17.cache.jB = nil
    tbl17.jB = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.jB
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local Shot = tbl17.kW()
        local index2 = {}
        index2.__index = index2

        local function isCandidateValid(fighterState, allowDeflecting, isMeleeQuery)
            if not fighterState or not fighterState.IsEnemy or fighterState:IsInvincible() then
                return false
            end
            local state = fighterState.Character and fighterState.Character.State
            if not state or not state.Alive or not state.RootPart then
                return false
            end
            Shot.UpdateResolver(fighterState, state)
            local melee = fighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
            if melee ~= nil and melee:IsDeflecting() then
                if not allowDeflecting and not isMeleeQuery then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end

        local function wrapTarget(fighterState)
            return { FighterState = fighterState, AliveState = fighterState.Character.State }
        end

        function index2.new(fighters, playerTags)
            return setmetatable({ _fighters = fighters, _playerTags = playerTags }, index2)
        end

        function index2:GetTarget(canBypassDeflect, isMeleeQuery)
            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local prioritizeHackers = cfg.PrioritizeHackers
            local priorityMode = cfg.TargetPriority or "Threat (Katana/Knife)"
            local allowDeflect = canBypassDeflect == true or cfg.KatanaCounter == "SwapBypass" or cfg.KatanaCounter == "MeleeBackstab"

            local localState = self._fighters.LocalState
            local myPos = (localState and localState.Character and localState.Character.State and localState.Character.State.RootPart)
                and localState.Character.State.RootPart.Position
                or Vector3.zero
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vpCenter = cam and (cam.ViewportSize * 0.5) or Vector2.new(960, 540)

            local bestFighter = nil
            local bestScore = math.huge

            for plr, fighterState in pairs(self._fighters.EnemyByPlayer) do
                if isCandidateValid(fighterState, allowDeflect, isMeleeQuery) then
                    local state = fighterState.Character.State
                    local rootPos = state.RootPart.Position
                    local dist = (rootPos - myPos).Magnitude

                    local hum = state.Humanoid
                    local hp = (hum and hum.Health) or 100

                    local score = dist
                    if priorityMode == "Lowest HP" then
                        score = hp * 2.5 + dist * 0.05
                    elseif priorityMode == "Crosshair" and cam then
                        local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPos)
                        score = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - vpCenter).Magnitude
                    elseif priorityMode == "Threat (Katana/Knife)" then
                        local melee = fighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
                        local threatBonus = (melee ~= nil) and -800 or 0
                        score = dist + threatBonus
                    end

                    if prioritizeHackers and self._playerTags:Has(plr, "Hacker") then
                        score -= 100000
                    end

                    local melee = fighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
                    if melee ~= nil and melee:IsDeflecting() and not canBypassDeflect and not isMeleeQuery then
                        score += 5000
                    end

                    if score < bestScore then
                        bestScore = score
                        bestFighter = fighterState
                    end
                end
            end

            if bestFighter then
                return wrapTarget(bestFighter)
            end
            return nil
        end

        function index2:HasTargets()
            for _, fighterState in pairs(self._fighters.EnemyByPlayer) do
                if isCandidateValid(fighterState, true, true) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        function index2.IsSameTarget(a, b)
            return a.FighterState == b.FighterState and a.AliveState == b.AliveState
        end

        cached = { c = index2 }
        tbl17.cache.jB = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    tbl17.cache.jM = nil
    tbl17.jM = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.jM
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local Shot = tbl17.kW()

        local function slotNameOf(item)
            local idx = item.Index
            return idx == 1 and "Primary" or idx == 2 and "Secondary" or idx == 3 and "Melee" or nil
        end

        local function isSlotEnabled(slotName)
            return Store.Data.Ragebot.Weapons.Enabled[slotName]
        end

        local mod = {
            getAction = function(innerContext, target, isEquippedMelee)
                local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
                local weapons = cfg.Weapons
                local onEmpty = weapons.OnEmpty

                local targetDeflecting = false
                if target and target.FighterState then
                    local enemyMelee = target.FighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
                    if enemyMelee ~= nil and enemyMelee:IsDeflecting() then
                        targetDeflecting = true
                    end
                end

                if targetDeflecting then
                    local counterMode = cfg.KatanaCounter or "SwapBypass"
                    if counterMode == "HoldFire" then
                        return nil
                    elseif counterMode == "SwapBypass" then
                        for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
                            if Shot.KatanaBypassWeapons[item.Name] then
                                local hasAmmo = (item.__type ~= "Gun") or (item:GetAmmo() > 0)
                                if hasAmmo then
                                    if item:IsEquipped() then
                                        return { Type = "Attack", Item = item }
                                    else
                                        return { Type = "Swap", Item = item }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return nil
                    elseif counterMode == "MeleeBackstab" then
                        for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
                            if item.__type == "Melee" then
                                if item:IsEquipped() then
                                    return { Type = "Attack", Item = item }
                                else
                                    return { Type = "Swap", Item = item }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return nil
                    end
                end

                local bestAttackRank = math.huge
                local bestReloadRank = math.huge
                local anyEnabled = false
                local bestAttackItem = nil
                local bestReloadItem = nil

                for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
                    local slotName = slotNameOf(item)
                    if slotName ~= nil and isSlotEnabled(slotName) then
                        anyEnabled = true
                        local rank = table.find(weapons.Priority, slotName) or math.huge
                        if item.__type == "Gun" and item:GetAmmo() == 0 then
                            if item:GetAmmoReserve() > 0 and rank < bestReloadRank then
                                if onEmpty == "Reload" then
                                    bestAttackItem = item
                                    bestAttackRank = rank
                                else
                                    bestReloadRank = rank
                                    bestReloadItem = item
                                end
                            end
                        elseif bestAttackItem == nil or rank < bestAttackRank then
                            bestAttackItem = item
                            bestAttackRank = rank
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not anyEnabled then return nil end

                if bestAttackItem ~= nil then
                    local isEmptyGun = bestAttackItem.__type == "Gun" and bestAttackItem:GetAmmo() == 0
                    if bestAttackItem:IsEquipped() then
                        if isEmptyGun then
                            return { Type = "Reload", Item = bestAttackItem }
                        end
                        return { Type = "Attack", Item = bestAttackItem }
                    end
                    return { Type = "Swap", Item = bestAttackItem }
                end

                if onEmpty == "Swap" then return nil end

                if bestReloadItem ~= nil then
                    if bestReloadItem:IsEquipped() then
                        return { Type = "Reload", Item = bestReloadItem }
                    end
                    return { Type = "Swap", Item = bestReloadItem }
                end

                return nil
            end
        }

        cached = { c = mod }
        tbl17.cache.jM = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    tbl17.cache.jD = nil
    tbl17.jD = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.jD
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local ShootLock = tbl17.jA()
        local PitchDir = tbl17.jy()
        local PlanarLook = tbl17.jC()
        local Shot = tbl17.kW()

        local offsetAbove = Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0.05)
        local offsetBelow = Vector3.new(0, -3.85, 0.05)

        local encAboveCam = { ["\0"] = -9e37, ["\1"] = 0, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = -1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encAboveHit = { ["\0"] = 0, ["\1"] = -90000000, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = -1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encBelowCam = { ["\0"] = -9e37, ["\1"] = 0, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = 1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encBelowHit = { ["\0"] = 0, ["\1"] = 90000000, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = 1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encObjOffset = { ["\0"] = 0, ["\1"] = 1, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = 0, ["\4"] = 0, ["\5"] = 0 }

        local index2 = {}
        index2.__index = index2

        function index2.new(partGlue)
            return setmetatable({ _partGlue = partGlue, _shootLock = ShootLock.new() }, index2)
        end

        function index2:Plan(dt, target, gunItem, myRoot, ready)
            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local fighter = target.FighterState
            local alive = target.AliveState
            local hitboxHead = alive.HitboxHead
                or (alive.TargetPartsByName and alive.TargetPartsByName.HitboxHeadSmall)
                or alive.RootPart

            local rEntry = Shot.UpdateResolver(fighter, alive)
            local notBelow = PitchDir(fighter) ~= "Below"
            local baseOffset = notBelow and offsetAbove or offsetBelow

            local enemyMelee = fighter and fighter.ItemObserver and fighter.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
            if enemyMelee ~= nil then
                if cfg.RiotShieldBypass and enemyMelee.Name == "Riot Shield" and alive.RootPart then
                    local backVec = -alive.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 4.2
                    baseOffset = baseOffset + backVec + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
                elseif cfg.ElevatedKnifeCounter and enemyMelee.Name ~= "Riot Shield" then

--==========================================================================
--  Signal / Trove (Kicia's own small versions)
--==========================================================================
local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal
function Signal.new() return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} }, Signal) end
function Signal:Connect(fn)
    local h = { fn = fn, connected = true }
    table.insert(self._handlers, h)
    local sig = self
    return {
        Connected = true,
        Disconnect = function(c)
            if not h.connected then return end
            h.connected = false
            c.Connected = false
            local i = table.find(sig._handlers, h)
            if i then table.remove(sig._handlers, i) end
        end,
    }
end
function Signal:Once(fn)
    local c
    c = self:Connect(function(...) c:Disconnect(); fn(...) end)
    return c
end
function Signal:Fire(...)
    local list = table.clone(self._handlers)
    for _, h in ipairs(list) do
        if h.connected then task.spawn(h.fn, ...) end
    end
end
function Signal:FireSync(...)
    for _, h in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
        if h.connected then h.fn(...) end
    end
end
function Signal:Destroy() table.clear(self._handlers) end
K.Signal = Signal

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove
function Trove.new(name) return setmetatable({ _name = name, _items = {} }, Trove) end
local function cleanItem(o)
    local t = typeof(o)
    if t == "RBXScriptConnection" then o:Disconnect()
    elseif t == "Instance" then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
    elseif t == "thread" then pcall(task.cancel, o)
    elseif type(o) == "function" then pcall(o)
    elseif type(o) == "table" then
        --  some objects (Kicia's signal connections) error on unknown fields
        local function member(k)
            local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
            return ok and type(v) == "function" and v or nil
        end
        local cancel, getStatus = member("cancel"), member("getStatus")
        if cancel and getStatus then pcall(cancel, o); return end
        local destroy = member("Destroy")
        if destroy then pcall(destroy, o); return end
        local disconnect = member("Disconnect")
        if disconnect then pcall(disconnect, o) end
    end
end
function Trove:Add(o) table.insert(self._items, o); return o end
function Trove:Connect(sig, fn) return self:Add(sig:Connect(fn)) end
function Trove:Extend() return self:Add(Trove.new(self._name)) end
function Trove:Remove(o, keep)
    local i = table.find(self._items, o)
    if i then
        table.remove(self._items, i)
        if not keep then cleanItem(o) end
    end
end
--  Promise held until it settles; cancelled if the trove is cleaned first.
function Trove:AddPromise(promise)
    if tostring(promise:getStatus()) == "Started" then
        self:Add(promise)
        promise:finally(function()
            if not self._cleaning then self:Remove(promise, true) end
        end)
    end
    return promise
end
--  Sub-trove that cleans itself up when `instance` is destroyed.
function Trove:AttachExtend(instance)
    local sub = self:Extend()
    sub:Connect(instance.Destroying, function() self:Remove(sub) end)
    return sub
end
function Trove:Clean()
    local items = self._items
    self._items = {}
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #items, 1, -1 do cleanItem(items[i]) end
    self._cleaning = false
end
Trove.Destroy = Trove.Clean
K.Trove = Trove
