print("[LeeLin.gg] ready")

do
    local Store = tbl17.bG()
    local rageDefaults = Store.Default and Store.Default.Ragebot
    local rageData = Store.Data and Store.Data.Ragebot

    local V3_DEFAULTS = {
        Enabled = false,
        TargetPriority = "Threat (Katana/Knife)",
        KatanaCounter = "SwapBypass",
        RiotShieldBypass = false,
        ElevatedKnifeCounter = false,
        WallbangV2 = false,
        ManipRadius = 16.5,
        ManipSamples = 24,
        TeleportV2Origin = false,
        ResolveSubterranean = false,
        ResolvePanicJitter = false,
        BacktrackWindow = 220,
        MultiPointHitscan = false,
        PredictionScale = 1.0,
        RapidFireBurst = 1,
    }

    for k, v in pairs(V3_DEFAULTS) do
        if rageDefaults and rageDefaults[k] == nil then rageDefaults[k] = v end
        if rageData and rageData[k] == nil then rageData[k] = v end
    end

    local KATANA_BYPASS_WEAPONS = {
        ["RPG"] = true,
        ["Grenade Launcher"] = true,
        ["Flare Gun"] = true,
        ["Exogun"] = true,
        ["Bow"] = true,
        ["Crossbow"] = true,
        ["Spray"] = true,
        ["Flamethrower"] = true,
    }

    local MELEE_WEAPONS = {
        ["Knife"] = true,
        ["Katana"] = true,
        ["Scythe"] = true,
        ["Chainsaw"] = true,
        ["Fists"] = true,
        ["Trowel"] = true,
        ["Battle Axe"] = true,
        ["Riot Shield"] = true,
    }

    local ResolverCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local groundRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    groundRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    groundRayParams.IgnoreWater = true

    local function isFiniteVec(v)
        return typeof(v) == "Vector3"
            and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
            and math.abs(v.X) < 1e9 and math.abs(v.Y) < 1e9 and math.abs(v.Z) < 1e9
    end

    local function updateTargetResolver(fighterState, aliveState)
        if not (fighterState and aliveState and aliveState.Alive and aliveState.RootPart) then
            return nil
        end
        local now = os.clock()
        local entry = ResolverCache[fighterState]
        if not entry then
            entry = {
                history = {},
                emaVel = Vector3.zero,
                lastPos = nil,
                lastTick = now,
                lastGroundY = nil,
                jitterScore = 0,
            }
            ResolverCache[fighterState] = entry
        end

        local root = aliveState.RootPart
        local head = aliveState.HitboxHead
            or (aliveState.TargetPartsByName and aliveState.TargetPartsByName.HitboxHeadSmall)
            or root
        local rawPos = root.Position
        local rawHead = head.Position
        if not (isFiniteVec(rawPos) and isFiniteVec(rawHead)) then
            return entry
        end

        local dt = now - entry.lastTick
        if entry.lastPos and dt > 0.001 then
            local delta = rawPos - entry.lastPos
            local planar = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
            if planar > 0.01 and planar < 500 then
                local instVel = delta / math.max(dt, 0.016)
                if entry.emaVel.Magnitude > 1 then
                    local dot = instVel.Unit:Dot(entry.emaVel.Unit)
                    if dot < -0.3 and planar > 2.0 then
                        entry.jitterScore = math.min(entry.jitterScore + 1, 14)
                    else
                        entry.jitterScore = math.max(entry.jitterScore - 0.5, 0)
                    end
                end
                local alpha = (entry.jitterScore >= 3) and 0.12 or 0.4
                entry.emaVel = entry.emaVel:Lerp(instVel, alpha)
            end
        end
        entry.lastPos = rawPos
        entry.lastTick = now

        local resolvedRoot = rawPos
        local resolvedHead = rawHead
        local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot

        if cfg.ResolveSubterranean then
            groundRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { aliveState.Model, workspace.CurrentCamera }
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(rawPos + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), Vector3.new(0, -150, 0), groundRayParams)
            if hit then
                entry.lastGroundY = hit.Position.Y + 3.0
            end
            local floorY = entry.lastGroundY
            if floorY and (rawPos.Y < floorY - 4.2 or rawPos.Y < -50) then
                local hOff = rawHead.Y - rawPos.Y
                resolvedRoot = Vector3.new(rawPos.X, floorY, rawPos.Z)
                resolvedHead = Vector3.new(rawHead.X, floorY + hOff, rawHead.Z)
            end
        end

        if cfg.ResolvePanicJitter and entry.jitterScore >= 3 and #entry.history >= 4 then
            local sumR, sumH, cnt = resolvedRoot, resolvedHead, 1
            for i = #entry.history, math.max(1, #entry.history - 6), -1 do
                sumR += entry.history[i].rootPos
                sumH += entry.history[i].headPos
                cnt += 1
            end
            resolvedRoot = sumR / cnt
            resolvedHead = sumH / cnt
        end

        table.insert(entry.history, {
            t = now,
            rootPos = resolvedRoot,
            headPos = resolvedHead,
            vel = entry.emaVel,
        })

        local windowSec = math.clamp((cfg.BacktrackWindow or 220) / 1000, 0.05, 0.4)
        local cutoff = now - windowSec
        while #entry.history > 1 and entry.history[1].t < cutoff do
            table.remove(entry.history, 1)
        end

        entry.resolvedRoot = resolvedRoot
        entry.resolvedHead = resolvedHead
        return entry
    end

    tbl17.cache.kW = nil
    tbl17.kW = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.kW
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local Origins = tbl17.cG()
        local Blocking = tbl17.da()
        local Shot = {}
        local nativeSizes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        local OCTANT_DIRS = {
            Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
            Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
            Vector3.new(0.707, 0, 0.707), Vector3.new(-0.707, 0, 0.707),
            Vector3.new(0.707, 0, -0.707), Vector3.new(-0.707, 0, -0.707),
            Vector3.new(0.707, 0.707, 0), Vector3.new(-0.707, 0.707, 0),
            Vector3.new(0, 0.707, 0.707), Vector3.new(0, 0.707, -0.707),
            Vector3.new(0.577, 0.577, 0.577), Vector3.new(-0.577, 0.577, -0.577),
            Vector3.new(0.577, 0.577, -0.577), Vector3.new(-0.577, 0.577, 0.577),
            Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
        }

        function Shot.Number(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and math.abs(v) < 1e9 end
        function Shot.Vector(v)
            return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and Shot.Number(v.X) and Shot.Number(v.Y) and Shot.Number(v.Z)
        end
        function Shot.Frame(v)
            if typeof(v) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
            for _, n in { v:GetComponents() } do if not Shot.Number(n) then return false end end
            return true
        end

        function Shot.Target(target)
            local state = target and target.AliveState
            local fighter = target and target.FighterState
            if not state or not state.Alive or not state.RootPart or not state.RootPart.Parent or not Shot.Vector(state.RootPart.Position) then
                return
            end
            if fighter and fighter.Character and fighter.Character.State ~= state then return end
            if state.Humanoid and state.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

            updateTargetResolver(fighter, state)

            local head = state.HitboxHead
            if not head or not head.Parent or not Shot.Vector(head.Position) or (head.Position - state.RootPart.Position).Magnitude > 24 then
                head = state.TargetPartsByName and state.TargetPartsByName.HitboxHeadSmall
            end
            if (not head or not head.Parent) and Store.Data.Ragebot.MultiPointHitscan then
                head = state.Model:FindFirstChild("Head") or state.Model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or state.RootPart
            end
            if not head or not head.Parent or not Shot.Vector(head.Position) then return end
            return head, state
        end

        function Shot.Cooldown(item, heavy)
            local info = item.Info or item._info or {}
            local cooldown = heavy and (info.HeavyAttackCooldown or info.AttackCooldown) or (info.ShootCooldown or info.AttackCooldown)
            if not Shot.Number(cooldown) or cooldown <= 0 then cooldown = item.__type == "Gun" and 1 / 60 or 0.15 end
            if item.__type == "Gun" then
                local burst = Shot.Number(info.ShootBurst) and math.clamp(info.ShootBurst, 1, 32) or 1
                local interval = Shot.Number(info.ShootBurstCooldown) and math.max(0, info.ShootBurstCooldown) or 0
                cooldown = math.max(cooldown, interval) + (burst - 1) * interval
            end
            return math.clamp(cooldown, 1 / 120, 10)
        end

        function Shot.Origin(controller, root)
            if controller then
                local anchor = controller:GetServerOriginAnchor()
                if Shot.Frame(anchor) then return anchor.Position end
            end
            if root and root.Parent and Shot.Vector(root.Position) then
                return root.Position + Origins.getServerOriginOffset(false)
            end
        end

        function Shot.Pose(target, item, root, controller, melee, params)
            local head, state = Shot.Target(target)
            if not head then return end
            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local crouching = controller and controller:IsCrouching() or false
            local offset = Origins.getServerOriginOffset(crouching)
            local info = item.Info or item._info or {}
            local distance = melee and 2.15 or (cfg.WallbangV2 and math.clamp(cfg.ManipRadius or 16.5, 4, 28) or 6)

            local explosive = item.Name == "RPG" or item.Name == "Grenade Launcher" or item.Name == "Flare Gun" or item.Name == "Exogun"
            if explosive then
                local radius = info.ExplosionRadius or info.SplashRadius
                distance = math.max(24, Shot.Number(radius) and radius + 6 or 0)
            end
            if melee then
                local reach = info.Range or info.AttackRange
                if Shot.Number(reach) then distance = math.clamp(reach * 0.42, 0.75, 2.5) end
            end

            local fighter = target.FighterState
            local rEntry = fighter and ResolverCache[fighter]
            local headPos = melee and head.Position or ((rEntry and rEntry.resolvedHead) or head.Position)

            local look = state.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector
            local bounds
            if item.__type == "Gun" and fighter then
                local ok, constraint = pcall(Blocking.resolveShotConstraint, item, fighter, "Planning")
                if ok and constraint and Shot.Vector(constraint.Look) then
                    look = constraint.Look
                    bounds = constraint.Bounds
                end
            end
            if not Shot.Vector(look) or look.Magnitude < 0.001 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            flat = flat.Magnitude < 0.001 and Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) or flat.Unit
            local side = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)

            if params then
                local excluded = { state.Model }
                if root and root.Parent then table.insert(excluded, root.Parent) end
                if workspace.CurrentCamera then table.insert(excluded, workspace.CurrentCamera) end
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
            end

            local enemyMelee = fighter and fighter.ItemObserver and fighter.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
            local hasEnemyKnife = enemyMelee ~= nil and enemyMelee.Name ~= "Riot Shield"
            local extraY = (cfg.ElevatedKnifeCounter and hasEnemyKnife and not melee) and 6.5 or 0

            if not melee and cfg.RiotShieldBypass and enemyMelee and enemyMelee.Name == "Riot Shield" then
                local rearOrigin = headPos - (flat * math.max(distance * 0.55, 3.5)) + Vector3.new(0, 1.5 + extraY, 0)
                local delta = headPos - rearOrigin
                if not params or not workspace:Raycast(rearOrigin, delta, params) then
                    return CFrame.lookAt(rearOrigin - offset, headPos), head
                end
            end

            local directions = melee and { -flat, side, -side, flat } or OCTANT_DIRS
            local heights = extraY > 0 and { extraY, extraY + 3, 2, 0 } or { 0, 2.5, 5.5, -2.0, 4.0 }
            local radii = cfg.WallbangV2 and { distance * 0.4, distance * 0.7, distance } or { distance }

            for _, r in ipairs(radii) do
                for _, height in ipairs(heights) do
                    for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do
                        local origin = headPos + direction * r + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
                        local delta = headPos - origin
                        if delta.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                            local dot = delta.Unit:Dot(look.Unit)
                            local safe = not bounds or ((bounds.MinDot == nil or dot >= bounds.MinDot + 0.03) and (bounds.MaxDot == nil or dot <= bounds.MaxDot - 0.03))
                            if safe and (not params or not workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params)) then
                                return CFrame.lookAt(origin - offset, headPos), head
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if rEntry and #rEntry.history > 1 then
                for i = #rEntry.history - 1, 1, -1 do
                    local btHead = rEntry.history[i].headPos
                    local origin = btHead - flat * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 2 + extraY, 0)
                    local delta = btHead - origin
                    if not params or not workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, params) then
                        return CFrame.lookAt(origin - offset, btHead), head
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        function Shot.RememberSize(part, size) nativeSizes[part] = size end

        function Shot.Hit(part, origin)
            local size = nativeSizes[part] or part.Size
            if not Shot.Vector(size) or size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 or size.Z <= 0 then return end
            local localOrigin = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(origin)
            local half = size * 0.5
            local ratio = math.max(math.abs(localOrigin.X) / half.X, math.abs(localOrigin.Y) / half.Y, math.abs(localOrigin.Z) / half.Z)
            if not Shot.Number(ratio) or ratio < 0.000001 then return end
            return { Part = part, ObjectSpace = localOrigin / ratio }
        end

        function Shot.Aim(controller, root, item, target)
            local head, state = Shot.Target(target)
            local origin = Shot.Origin(controller, root)
            if not head or not origin or not Shot.Vector(origin) then return end

            local fighter = target.FighterState
            local rEntry = fighter and ResolverCache[fighter]
            local point = item.__type == "Melee" and head.Position or ((rEntry and rEntry.resolvedHead) or head.Position)
            local delta = point - origin
            if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end

            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local predScale = cfg.PredictionScale or 1.0
            local velocity = (rEntry and rEntry.emaVel) or state.Velocity or state.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity

            local info = item.Info or item._info or {}
            if item.__type == "Gun" and not item.IsRaycast then
                local speed = info.ProjectileSpeed or info.BulletSpeed
                if Shot.Number(speed) and speed > 0 and Shot.Vector(velocity) and velocity.Magnitude <= 350 then
                    local flight = math.clamp(delta.Magnitude / speed, 0, 0.45) * predScale
                    point += velocity * flight
                    local gravity = info.ProjectileGravity or info.BulletGravity
                    if Shot.Number(gravity) and gravity > 0 then
                        point += Vector3.new(0, gravity * 0.5 * flight * flight, 0)
                    end
                end
            elseif item.__type == "Gun" and Shot.Vector(velocity) and velocity.Magnitude > 2 and velocity.Magnitude <= 300 and predScale > 0 then
                point += velocity * (0.032 * predScale)
            end

            local frame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, point)
            if not Shot.Frame(frame) then return end
            return frame, (item.__type ~= "Gun" or item.IsRaycast) and Shot.Hit(head, origin) or nil
        end

        Shot.ResolverCache = ResolverCache
        Shot.UpdateResolver = updateTargetResolver
        Shot.KatanaBypassWeapons = KATANA_BYPASS_WEAPONS

        cached = { c = Shot }
        tbl17.cache.kW = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    tbl17.cache.jB = nil
    tbl17.jB = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.jB
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local Shot = tbl17.kW()
        local index2 = {}
        index2.__index = index2

        local function isCandidateValid(fighterState, allowDeflecting, isMeleeQuery)
            if not fighterState or not fighterState.IsEnemy or fighterState:IsInvincible() then
                return false
            end
            local state = fighterState.Character and fighterState.Character.State
            if not state or not state.Alive or not state.RootPart then
                return false
            end
            Shot.UpdateResolver(fighterState, state)
            local melee = fighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
            if melee ~= nil and melee:IsDeflecting() then
                if not allowDeflecting and not isMeleeQuery then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end

        local function wrapTarget(fighterState)
            return { FighterState = fighterState, AliveState = fighterState.Character.State }
        end

        function index2.new(fighters, playerTags)
            return setmetatable({ _fighters = fighters, _playerTags = playerTags }, index2)
        end

        function index2:GetTarget(canBypassDeflect, isMeleeQuery)
            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local prioritizeHackers = cfg.PrioritizeHackers
            local priorityMode = cfg.TargetPriority or "Threat (Katana/Knife)"
            local allowDeflect = canBypassDeflect == true or cfg.KatanaCounter == "SwapBypass" or cfg.KatanaCounter == "MeleeBackstab"

            local localState = self._fighters.LocalState
            local myPos = (localState and localState.Character and localState.Character.State and localState.Character.State.RootPart)
                and localState.Character.State.RootPart.Position
                or Vector3.zero
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vpCenter = cam and (cam.ViewportSize * 0.5) or Vector2.new(960, 540)

            local bestFighter = nil
            local bestScore = math.huge

            for plr, fighterState in pairs(self._fighters.EnemyByPlayer) do
                if isCandidateValid(fighterState, allowDeflect, isMeleeQuery) then
                    local state = fighterState.Character.State
                    local rootPos = state.RootPart.Position
                    local dist = (rootPos - myPos).Magnitude

                    local hum = state.Humanoid
                    local hp = (hum and hum.Health) or 100

                    local score = dist
                    if priorityMode == "Lowest HP" then
                        score = hp * 2.5 + dist * 0.05
                    elseif priorityMode == "Crosshair" and cam then
                        local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPos)
                        score = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - vpCenter).Magnitude
                    elseif priorityMode == "Threat (Katana/Knife)" then
                        local melee = fighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
                        local threatBonus = (melee ~= nil) and -800 or 0
                        score = dist + threatBonus
                    end

                    if prioritizeHackers and self._playerTags:Has(plr, "Hacker") then
                        score -= 100000
                    end

                    local melee = fighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
                    if melee ~= nil and melee:IsDeflecting() and not canBypassDeflect and not isMeleeQuery then
                        score += 5000
                    end

                    if score < bestScore then
                        bestScore = score
                        bestFighter = fighterState
                    end
                end
            end

            if bestFighter then
                return wrapTarget(bestFighter)
            end
            return nil
        end

        function index2:HasTargets()
            for _, fighterState in pairs(self._fighters.EnemyByPlayer) do
                if isCandidateValid(fighterState, true, true) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        function index2.IsSameTarget(a, b)
            return a.FighterState == b.FighterState and a.AliveState == b.AliveState
        end

        cached = { c = index2 }
        tbl17.cache.jB = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    tbl17.cache.jM = nil
    tbl17.jM = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.jM
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local Shot = tbl17.kW()

        local function slotNameOf(item)
            local idx = item.Index
            return idx == 1 and "Primary" or idx == 2 and "Secondary" or idx == 3 and "Melee" or nil
        end

        local function isSlotEnabled(slotName)
            return Store.Data.Ragebot.Weapons.Enabled[slotName]
        end

        local mod = {
            getAction = function(innerContext, target, isEquippedMelee)
                local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
                local weapons = cfg.Weapons
                local onEmpty = weapons.OnEmpty

                local targetDeflecting = false
                if target and target.FighterState then
                    local enemyMelee = target.FighterState.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
                    if enemyMelee ~= nil and enemyMelee:IsDeflecting() then
                        targetDeflecting = true
                    end
                end

                if targetDeflecting then
                    local counterMode = cfg.KatanaCounter or "SwapBypass"
                    if counterMode == "HoldFire" then
                        return nil
                    elseif counterMode == "SwapBypass" then
                        for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
                            if Shot.KatanaBypassWeapons[item.Name] then
                                local hasAmmo = (item.__type ~= "Gun") or (item:GetAmmo() > 0)
                                if hasAmmo then
                                    if item:IsEquipped() then
                                        return { Type = "Attack", Item = item }
                                    else
                                        return { Type = "Swap", Item = item }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return nil
                    elseif counterMode == "MeleeBackstab" then
                        for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
                            if item.__type == "Melee" then
                                if item:IsEquipped() then
                                    return { Type = "Attack", Item = item }
                                else
                                    return { Type = "Swap", Item = item }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        return nil
                    end
                end

                local bestAttackRank = math.huge
                local bestReloadRank = math.huge
                local anyEnabled = false
                local bestAttackItem = nil
                local bestReloadItem = nil

                for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
                    local slotName = slotNameOf(item)
                    if slotName ~= nil and isSlotEnabled(slotName) then
                        anyEnabled = true
                        local rank = table.find(weapons.Priority, slotName) or math.huge
                        if item.__type == "Gun" and item:GetAmmo() == 0 then
                            if item:GetAmmoReserve() > 0 and rank < bestReloadRank then
                                if onEmpty == "Reload" then
                                    bestAttackItem = item
                                    bestAttackRank = rank
                                else
                                    bestReloadRank = rank
                                    bestReloadItem = item
                                end
                            end
                        elseif bestAttackItem == nil or rank < bestAttackRank then
                            bestAttackItem = item
                            bestAttackRank = rank
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not anyEnabled then return nil end

                if bestAttackItem ~= nil then
                    local isEmptyGun = bestAttackItem.__type == "Gun" and bestAttackItem:GetAmmo() == 0
                    if bestAttackItem:IsEquipped() then
                        if isEmptyGun then
                            return { Type = "Reload", Item = bestAttackItem }
                        end
                        return { Type = "Attack", Item = bestAttackItem }
                    end
                    return { Type = "Swap", Item = bestAttackItem }
                end

                if onEmpty == "Swap" then return nil end

                if bestReloadItem ~= nil then
                    if bestReloadItem:IsEquipped() then
                        return { Type = "Reload", Item = bestReloadItem }
                    end
                    return { Type = "Swap", Item = bestReloadItem }
                end

                return nil
            end
        }

        cached = { c = mod }
        tbl17.cache.jM = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    tbl17.cache.jD = nil
    tbl17.jD = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.jD
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local ShootLock = tbl17.jA()
        local PitchDir = tbl17.jy()
        local PlanarLook = tbl17.jC()
        local Shot = tbl17.kW()

        local offsetAbove = Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0.05)
        local offsetBelow = Vector3.new(0, -3.85, 0.05)

        local encAboveCam = { ["\0"] = -9e37, ["\1"] = 0, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = -1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encAboveHit = { ["\0"] = 0, ["\1"] = -90000000, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = -1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encBelowCam = { ["\0"] = -9e37, ["\1"] = 0, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = 1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encBelowHit = { ["\0"] = 0, ["\1"] = 90000000, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = 1.5707963267948966, ["\4"] = 3.1415926535897931, ["\5"] = 3.1415926535897931 }
        local encObjOffset = { ["\0"] = 0, ["\1"] = 1, ["\2"] = 0, ["\3"] = 0, ["\4"] = 0, ["\5"] = 0 }

        local index2 = {}
        index2.__index = index2

        function index2.new(partGlue)
            return setmetatable({ _partGlue = partGlue, _shootLock = ShootLock.new() }, index2)
        end

        function index2:Plan(dt, target, gunItem, myRoot, ready)
            local cfg = Store.Data.Ragebot
            local fighter = target.FighterState
            local alive = target.AliveState
            local hitboxHead = alive.HitboxHead
                or (alive.TargetPartsByName and alive.TargetPartsByName.HitboxHeadSmall)
                or alive.RootPart

            local rEntry = Shot.UpdateResolver(fighter, alive)
            local notBelow = PitchDir(fighter) ~= "Below"
            local baseOffset = notBelow and offsetAbove or offsetBelow

            local enemyMelee = fighter and fighter.ItemObserver and fighter.ItemObserver:EquippedItemAsMelee()
            if enemyMelee ~= nil then
                if cfg.RiotShieldBypass and enemyMelee.Name == "Riot Shield" and alive.RootPart then
                    local backVec = -alive.RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 4.2
                    baseOffset = baseOffset + backVec + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
                elseif cfg.ElevatedKnifeCounter and enemyMelee.Name ~= "Riot Shield" then
                    baseOffset = baseOffset + Vector3.new(0, 6.5, 0)
                end
            end

            local gluedCF = self._partGlue:Acquire(myRoot, hitboxHead)
            local resolvedDelta = Vector3.zero
            if rEntry and rEntry.resolvedHead and isFiniteVec(rEntry.resolvedHead) then
                resolvedDelta = rEntry.resolvedHead - hitboxHead.Position
            end

            local poseCF
            if notBelow then
                poseCF = gluedCF + baseOffset + resolvedDelta
            else
                poseCF = PlanarLook(gluedCF.Position + baseOffset + resolvedDelta, hitboxHead.Position + resolvedDelta)
            end

            if not self._shootLock:ShouldFire(ready, dt * cfg.ShootFrames) then
                return CFrame.new(math.random(-1000000, 1000000), math.random(5000, 10000), math.random(-1000000, 1000000)), nil
            end

            local camPacket = notBelow and encAboveCam or encBelowCam
            local hitPacket = notBelow and encAboveHit or encBelowHit
            local burstMult = math.clamp(cfg.RapidFireMultiplier or 2, 1, 5)

            return poseCF, function()
                for _ = 1, burstMult do
                    gunItem:ShootEncoded(camPacket, hitPacket, hitboxHead, encObjOffset)
                end
            end
        end

        cached = { c = index2 }
        tbl17.cache.jD = cached
        return cached.c
    end

    local origJO = tbl17.jO()
    origJO.Update = function(arg, dt)
        local innerContext = arg._innerContext
        if innerContext == nil then
            arg:_Reset()
            return
        end
        local fighterState = innerContext.FighterState
        if fighterState.EnvironmentId == nil or not arg._enabled then
            arg:_Reset()
            return
        end
        local state = fighterState.Character.State
        if not state.Alive then
            arg:_Reset()
            return
        end

        local characterController = innerContext.CharacterController
        local clientCFrame = characterController:GetClientCFrame()
        local mode = Store.Data.Ragebot.Evasion.Mode

        local equippedItem = innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetEquipped()
        local isEquippedMelee = equippedItem ~= nil and equippedItem.__type == "Melee"

        local hasBypassWeapon = false
        local Shot = tbl17.kW()
        for _, item in pairs(innerContext.ItemBehaviors:GetItems()) do
            if Shot.KatanaBypassWeapons[item.Name] and (item.__type ~= "Gun" or item:GetAmmo() > 0) then
                hasBypassWeapon = true
                break
            end
        end

        local target = arg._targetSelection:GetTarget(hasBypassWeapon, isEquippedMelee)
        local action = arg._equipCoordinator:Prepare(innerContext,tbl17.jM().getAction(innerContext, target, isEquippedMelee))

        if mode == "Translocate" and arg._reloadGun == nil and (action == nil or action.Type ~= "Reload") and target == nil and action == nil then
            arg:_ApplyForcedCrouch(false)
            characterController:SetServerCFrame(tbl17.jK().compute(clientCFrame, arg._targetSelection:HasTargets()))
            return
        end

        if target ~= nil then
            arg._lastTargetWorld = target.AliveState.RootPart.Position
        else
            arg._lastTargetWorld = nil
        end

        local plan = arg:_Plan(dt, action, target, state.RootPart, clientCFrame, mode)
        arg._cloudyHudTarget = target
        arg._cloudyHudMeleeReason=action and action.Item and action.Item.__type=="Melee" and arg._meleeStrategy:GetBlockReason() or nil
        arg._cloudyHudActionType = action and action.Type or nil
        arg._cloudyHudUpdatedAt = os.clock()
        arg:_ApplyPlan(plan, target, innerContext)

        local reloadGun = arg._reloadGun
        if reloadGun ~= nil and arg._reloadReadyAt == nil and arg._pendingDepletionAmmo == nil and not reloadGun:IsReloading() then
            arg._reloadReadyAt = os.clock() + tbl17.cG().getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
        end

        arg:_ApplyForcedCrouch(plan.ShouldForceCrouch == true)
        local equippedGun = innerContext.ItemBehaviors:EquippedItemAsGun()
        local ammo = equippedGun ~= nil and equippedGun:GetAmmo() or 0
        local shotRequestCount = equippedGun ~= nil and equippedGun.ShotRequestCount or 0
        local weaponAction = plan.WeaponAction

        if weaponAction ~= nil then
            if action and action.Type == "Attack" and action.Item.__type == "Melee" then
                characterController:HeartbeatUpdate()
            end
            local didAct=weaponAction()
            if didAct~=false and action ~= nil and action.Type == "Attack" and target ~= nil then
                arg._cloudyHudAttackAt = os.clock()
                arg._cloudyHudAttackTarget = target
            end
            if equippedGun ~= nil and (equippedGun.ShotRequestCount - shotRequestCount) > 0 and equippedGun:GetExpectedAmmoAfterPendingShots() <= 0 then
                innerContext.CharacterController:SetServerCFrame(tbl17.jL().getImmune())
                local now2 = os.clock()
                arg._reloadGun = equippedGun
                arg._reloadReadyAt = now2 + tbl17.cG().getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
                arg._pendingDepletionAmmo = ammo
                arg._reloadAcknowledgementDeadline = now2 + tbl17.cG().getEstimatedRemoteDelay() + tbl17.cG().getEstimatedReplicationDelay()
            end
        end
    end

    local origIh = tbl17.ih()
    tbl17.cache.ih = nil
    tbl17.ih = function()
        local cached = tbl17.cache.ih
        if cached then return cached.c end

        local builder = function(grid)
            origIh(grid)

            local s = grid:AddSection({ Title = "HvH Counter", Side = "left" })
            s:AddDropdown({

            s:AddSlider({

            r:AddToggle({

            })
            r:AddSlider({

            r:AddSlider({
                Label = "Velocity Prediction Scale",
                Min = 0,
                Max = 2.5,
                Step = 0.05,
                Config = { "Ragebot", "PredictionScale" },
            })
        end

        cached = { c = builder }
        tbl17.cache.ih = cached
        return cached.c
    end
end


do
    -- Compatibility with Cloudy's status display and shared root-attachment owner.
    -- The donor Plan, encoded attacks and backstab timing remain unchanged.
    local Melee=tbl17.jE()
    Melee.GetBlockReason=function(self)
        local now=os.clock()
        if now>=(self._hitboxWindowUntil or -1) and now<(self._attackCooldown or -1) then
            return "Waiting for melee cooldown"
        end
    end
    local reset=Melee.ResetState
    Melee.ResetState=function(self)
        local root=self._gluedOurPart or self._nativeCleanupRoot
        reset(self)
        self._nativeCleanupRoot=nil
        if root and root.Parent and self._partGlue.FreeForNative then
            local ok,released=pcall(self._partGlue.FreeForNative,self._partGlue,root)
            if not ok or released==false then self._nativeCleanupRoot=root end
        end
    end
end

do
    -- Position/velocity swap adapted from message (35).txt's snapVoid path.
    -- Use the shared controller so the camera and local physics keep their real pose.
    local Store=tbl17.bG()
    local Ragebot=tbl17.jO()
    local OWNER="CloudyDesync"
    local LIMIT,DEAD=2147483646,1147483646
    local ROTATION=CFrame.Angles(math.pi,math.pi,math.pi)

    local function farCoordinate()
        local magnitude=math.random(DEAD+1,LIMIT)
        return math.random(0,1)==0 and -magnitude or magnitude
    end
    local function farVector()
        return Vector3.new(farCoordinate(),farCoordinate(),farCoordinate())
    end

    function Ragebot:_ClearCloudyDesync()
        local controller=self._cloudyDesyncController
        if not controller then return end
        self._cloudyDesyncController=nil
        controller:SetServerCFrame(nil,OWNER)
        controller:SetServerVelocity(nil,nil,OWNER)
    end

    local initialize=Ragebot._Initialize
    Ragebot._Initialize=function(self,...)
        initialize(self,...)
        self._trove:Connect(Store:GetPropertyChangedSignal({"Ragebot","Desync","Enabled"}),function()
            local config=Store.Data.Ragebot.Desync
            if type(config)~="table" or config.Enabled~=true then self:_ClearCloudyDesync() end
        end)
    end

    local update=Ragebot.Update
    Ragebot.Update=function(self,...)
        -- Release the previous frame before native selection or any early return.
        self:_ClearCloudyDesync()
        return update(self,...)
    end

    local applyPlan=Ragebot._ApplyPlan
    Ragebot._ApplyPlan=function(self,plan,target,inner)
        self:_ClearCloudyDesync()
        applyPlan(self,plan,target,inner)
        local config=Store.Data.Ragebot.Desync
        if type(config)~="table" or config.Enabled~=true or not self._enabled then return end
        local fighter=inner.FighterState
        local state=fighter and fighter.Character.State
        if not fighter or fighter.EnvironmentId==nil or not state or not state.Alive then return end
        -- Equip, reload and attack callbacks retain their existing network origins.
        if plan.WeaponAction~=nil or plan.IsAimPose or self._reloadGun~=nil then return end
        local controller=inner.CharacterController
        self._cloudyDesyncController=controller
        local velocity=farVector()
        controller:SetServerCFrame(CFrame.new(farVector())*ROTATION,OWNER,30)
        controller:SetServerVelocity(velocity,velocity,OWNER)
    end

    local reset=Ragebot._Reset
    Ragebot._Reset=function(self,...)
        self:_ClearCloudyDesync()
        return reset(self,...)
    end
    local setEnabled=Ragebot.SetEnabled
    Ragebot.SetEnabled=function(self,enabled,...)
        if not enabled then self:_ClearCloudyDesync() end
        return setEnabled(self,enabled,...)
    end
    local destroy=Ragebot.Destroy
    Ragebot.Destroy=function(self,...)
        self:_ClearCloudyDesync()
        return destroy(self,...)
    end

    local buildRagebot=tbl17.ih()
    tbl17.cache.ih=nil
    tbl17.ih=function()
        local cached=tbl17.cache.ih
        if not cached then
            cached={c=function(grid)
                buildRagebot(grid)
                local section=grid:AddSection({Title="不同步",Side="right"})
                section:AddToggle({Label="啟用不同步",Config={"Ragebot","Desync","Enabled"}})
            end}
            tbl17.cache.ih=cached
        end
        return cached.c
    end
end

local function makeDraggable(obj, handle)
    handle = handle or obj
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = obj.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end

local function safeRequireModule(module)
	if not module then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(function() return require(module) end)
	return ok and result or nil
end

-- Resilient background loader: polls up to 30 times (6s total) without blocking
local elib, clib, ilib, consts, dctrl
for _ = 1, 30 do
    pcall(function()
        if not rmods then rmods = reps:FindFirstChild("Modules") end
        if not ctrls and lps then ctrls = lps:FindFirstChild("Controllers") end
        if rmods then
            if not elib then elib = safeRequireModule(rmods:FindFirstChild("EnumLibrary")) end
            if not clib then clib = safeRequireModule(rmods:FindFirstChild("CosmeticLibrary")) end
            if not ilib then ilib = safeRequireModule(rmods:FindFirstChild("ItemLibrary")) end
            if not consts then consts = safeRequireModule(rmods:FindFirstChild("CONSTANTS")) end
        end
        if ctrls and not dctrl then
            dctrl = safeRequireModule(ctrls:FindFirstChild("PlayerDataController"))
        end
    end)
    if elib and clib and ilib and consts and dctrl and clib.Cosmetics then
        break
    end
    task.wait(0.2)
end

if elib and elib.WaitForEnumBuilder then
	pcall(function() elib:WaitForEnumBuilder() end)
end

if not (elib and clib and ilib and consts and dctrl and clib.Cosmetics) then
    warn("[Sleepy Hub] Game modules still replicating, cosmetic changer will retry in background")
    return
end
local coss = clib.Cosmetics

local function findDescendantByName(parent, name)
	if not parent then return nil end
	local direct = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if direct then return direct end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == name then
			return descendant
		end
	end
	return nil
end
